articles.title: Ledakan terdengar di Riyadh setelah 'ancaman udara bermusuhan' peringatan, laporan mengatakan
articles.description: Ledakan terdengar di Riyadh setelah peringatan ancaman udara musuh, laporan mengatakan ledakan terdengar di ibukota Saudi Riyadh pada hari Rabu, menurut seorang jurnalis dan warga AFP, sehari setelah 11 orang terluka di sebuah perumahan - klaim serangan terhadap distrik keuangan kota. Ledakan terjadi sekitar tengah malam waktu setempat setelah pihak berwenang mengeluarkan peringatan dari "ancaman udara bermusuhan", yang diangkat segera setelah. Penduduk di utara dan timur Riyadh dikonfirmasi mendengar ledakan, dengan satu mengatakan jendela rumah mereka "bergetar keras".
articles.originalTitle: Explosion heard in Riyadh after 'hostile aerial threat' warning, report says
articles.originalDescription: Explosion heard in Riyadh after 'hostile aerial threat' warning, report says An explosion was heard in Saudi capital Riyadh on Wednesday, according to an AFP journalist and residents, a day after 11 people were wounded in a Houthi-claimed attack on the city's financial district. The explosion occurred around midnight local time after authorities issued an alert warning of a "hostile aerial threat", which was lifted shortly after. Residents in northern and eastern Riyadh confirmed hearing the blast, with one saying their house windows "shook violently".

articles.title: Ledakan keras rock Riyadh sebagai serangan Houthis Saudi port
articles.description: Ledakan keras Riyadh sebagai pelabuhan Houthis Saudi yang dijatuhkan oleh staf MEE di Wed, 11 / 25 / 2026 - 21: 13 Putra Mahkota Muhammad bin Salman diharapkan untuk perjalanan ke AS bulan depan untuk G-20 dalam perjalanan pertama sejak awal perang foto ini menunjukkan pandangan dari skyline Riyadh pada 23 November 2026 Ledakan ringan mengguncang Riyadh pada hari Rabu sebagai Houthis yang mengklaim serangan terhadap Arab Saudi, pelabuhan laut merah di Jedddh dan kerajaan Jadru terus berlanjut. Houthis mengatakan bahwa keduanya menyerang pelabuhan "menyebabkan kerusakan" sementara Saudi- dipimpin koalisi mengakui bahwa proyektil menghantam pelabuhan Jazan, mengakibatkan kerusakan kecil dan tidak ada korban. Port pemogokan mengikuti serangan terhadap Ras Tanura, kilang terbesar Arab Saudi. Argus Media, yang meliputi pasar komoditas, mengatakan Houthis mendarat dua pukulan sukses di fasilitas, satu di kilang dan satu di terminal ekspor. Houthis mengatakan mereka membom Ras Tanura sebagai pembalasan atas serangan Saudi di pelabuhan Hodeidah dikendalikan oleh kelompok. Arab Saudi menembaki sebagian besar rudal Houthi dan drone menembak itu, pejabat Arab dan Barat memberitahu Mata Timur Tengah, tetapi telah gagal untuk melindungi aset kunci seperti fasilitas energi, pusat-pusat keuangan dan bandara. Putra Mahkota Mohammed bin Salman telah mencoba untuk menyatukan AS dan negara-negara regional ke sisinya. Mesir, Pakistan, Turki dan Suriah semua telah mengirim atau berkomitmen untuk memberikan dukungan militer ke Arab Saudi, tetapi dengan pengecualian Suriah - yang telah mengirim operator drone - bantuan adalah defensif. Putra Mahkota bertemu dengan kepala komando AS Laksamana Brad Cooper, komandan pasukan di Timur Tengah, minggu lalu. MEE pertama kali melaporkan pertemuan yang direncanakan, yang ketiga sejak pertempuran dengan Houthis dilanjutkan pada bulan Juli. articles.originalTitle: Loud explosions rock Riyadh as Houthis attack Saudi ports
articles.originalDescription: Loud explosions rock Riyadh as Houthis attack Saudi ports Submitted by MEE staff on Wed, 11/25/2026 - 21:13 Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman expected to travel to the US next month for G-20 in first trip since start of war This aerial photograph shows a view of the Riyadh skyline on 23 November 2026 Off Fresh explosions rocked Riyadh on Wednesday as Yemen's Houthis claimed attacks on Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea ports of Jeddah and Jazan, as the kingdom’s deterrence and defensive capabilities continue to be challenged. The Houthis said that both strikes on the ports “resulted in damage” while the Saudi-led coalition acknowledged that a projectile hit the port of Jazan, resulting in minor damage and no casualties. The port strikes followed an attack on Ras Tanura, Saudi Arabia’s largest refinery. Argus Media, which covers commodity markets, said the Houthis landed two successful blows on the facility, one at the refinery and one at the export terminal. The Houthis say they bombed Ras Tanura as retaliation for the Saudi attack on the port of Hodeidah controlled by the group. Saudi Arabia is shooting down the majority of Houthi missiles and drones fired at it, Arab and Western officials tell Middle East Eye, but it has failed to protect key assets like energy facilities, financial centres and airports. Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has tried to rally the US and regional states to his side. Egypt, Pakistan, Turkey and Syria have all sent or committed to delivering military support to Saudi Arabia, but with the exception of Syria - which has sent drone operators - the assistance is defensive. The Crown Prince met US Central Command chief admiral Brad Cooper, the commander of forces in the Middle East, last week. MEE first reported the planned meeting, which was the third since fighting with the Houthis resumed in July. articles.originalTitle: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepts Houthi drone near Jeddah Islamic Port
articles.originalDescription: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepts Houthi drone near Jeddah Islamic Port The Saudi-led coalition said on Wednesday it intercepted and destroyed a drone launched by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis near Jeddah Islamic Port on Saudi Arabia's Red Sea coast, adding that no civilians were injured by debris from the interception. The Houthis said they had attacked the port. Jeddah Islamic Port is a major Saudi maritime gateway on the Red Sea and a key hub for cargo and container traffic. A picture taken on 1 March 2022 shows a view of cranes and shipping containers at a loading dock of Jeddah's Islamic Seaport on Saudi Arabia's western Red Sea coast (AFP)

articles.title: Investasi logistik dan transportasi Saudi akan mencapai SR45 miliar pada tahun 2026
articles.description: RIYADH - Menteri Transportasi dan Logistik Saleh Al- Jasser mengatakan sektor transportasi dan logistik Arab Saudi telah membuat kemajuan yang signifikan, melewati beberapa Saudi Vision 2030 target lebih cepat dari jadwal. Dia mengatakan bahwa komitmen investasi baru di sektor diharapkan untuk mencapai SR45 miliar pada tahun 2026, meskipun tantangan regional. Berbicara di diskusi panel berjudul "Kemampuan Logistik dan teknis menghubungkan dunia" di Forum Budget 2027 di Riyadh pada hari Rabu, Al- Jasser mengatakan sektor transportasi dan logistik beroperasi sebagai sistem terintegrasi yang meliputi regulasi dan legislatif antar penerbangan sipil, transportasi, jalan raya, dan pelabuhan, bekerja dalam penutupan dengan sektor swasta. Dia menggambarkan sektor swasta sebagai pengemudi utama investasi dan sumber daya yang mendasari Transportasi Nasional dan Strategi Logistik, mencatat bahwa Kerajaan telah menarik ratusan miliar riyal dalam investasi berkualitas tinggi dari perusahaan-perusahaan internasional besar dalam beberapa tahun terakhir. Dia mengutip investasi Maersk di Jeddah Islam Port, yang menjadi tuan rumah terbesar di perusahaan di seluruh dunia. Fasilitas ini telah mencapai pendudukan penuh, mendorong perusahaan untuk mencari kesempatan investasi lebih lanjut di Kingdom. Pelabuhan Islam Jeddah saat ini memiliki 17 zona logistik terpadu. Al- Jasser juga mencatat bahwa multibillion-riyal perjanjian investasi ditandatangani tahun ini dengan CMA CGM untuk mengembangkan terminal di pelabuhan, bersama kontrak untuk lima zona logistik baru. Di sektor kereta api, ia menyoroti pengadaan 20 trainset baru untuk Haramain Highspeed Railway, selain saham rolling baru untuk jalur kereta api Timur, Utara, dan pertambangan kereta api. Dia menambahkan kontrak yang telah ditandatangani untuk melacak jalur kereta tambang, yang mendukung transportasi tiga jenis mineral, sementara proyek untuk menghubungkan jaringan kereta api Kerajaan melalui link di Riyadh telah mencapai tahap
articles.originalTitle: Saudi transport and logistics investments set to hit SR45 billion in 2026
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Minister of Transport and Logistics Saleh Al-Jasser said Saudi Arabia’s transport and logistics sector has made significant progress, surpassing several Saudi Vision 2030 targets ahead of schedule. He said that new investment commitments in the sector are expected to reach SR45 billion in 2026, despite regional challenges.Speaking at a panel discussion titled "Logistical and technical capabilities connecting the world" at the Budget 2027 Forum in Riyadh on Wednesday, Al-Jasser said the transport and logistics sector operates as an integrated system encompassing regulatory and legislative entities across civil aviation, transport, roads, and ports, working in closecoordination with the private sector.He described the private sector as the main driver of investment and resources underpinning the National Transport and Logistics Strategy, noting that the Kingdom has attracted hundreds of billions of riyals in high-quality investments from major international companies in recent years.He cited Maersk's investment at Jeddah Islamic Port, which hosts the company's largest logistics zone worldwide. The facility has reached full occupancy, prompting the company to seek further investment opportunities in the Kingdom.Jeddah Islamic Port currently has 17 integrated logistics zones. Al-Jasser also noted that multibillion-riyal investment agreements were signed this year with CMA CGM to develop a terminal at the port, alongside contracts for five new logistics zones. In the railway sector, he highlighted the procurement of 20 new trainsets for the Haramain High-Speed Railway, in addition to new rolling stock for the Eastern, Northern, and mining railway lines.He added that contracts had been signed to double-track the mining railway line, which supports the transportation of three types of minerals, while the project to connect the Kingdom's railway networks through a link in Riyadh had reached its final tendering stage. articles.title: PIF mengamankan inaugural S & P A + peringkat kredit dengan stabil outlook
articles.description: RIYADH - The Public Investment Fund (PIF) mengumumkan pada hari Rabu bahwa S & P Global Ratings telah menetapkan pelantikan A + long-term istilah asing dan penagihan mata uang lokal peringkat kredit, dengan outlook stabil. Rating jangka pendek PIF-1 masih belum berubah, dengan peringkat PIF sejalan dengan Arab Saudi. Rating A + mencerminkan kepercayaan dalam strategi jangka panjang dan posisi keuangan yang kuat. Ini menambah profil kredit yang sudah kuat, sehingga mendukung basis pendanaan berkelanjutan dan strategi investasi jangka panjang. Penilaian S & P menyoroti profil pendanaan diversifikasi PIF, posisi pengaruh moderat dan fokus pada realisasi nilai di bawah strategi PIF 2026- 2030, serta peran penting dalam mendorong perubahan ekonomi Arab Saudi. Kepala Keuangan PIF Ziyad Alfawzan berkata: "Peringkat inaugural A + panjang dari S & P menandai tonggak penting dalam pengembangan profil kredit dan rencana pendanaan jangka panjang kami. PIF memegang peringkat kredit jangka panjang yang kuat dari S & P, Moody dan Fitch, mencerminkan PIF yang didiversifikasi dan berkelanjutan basis pendanaan dan kekuatan profil keuangan dan pemerintahan. Ini mencerminkan kepercayaan diri dalam strategi jangka panjang PIF, saat kita memajukan fase realisasi nilai 2026- 2030." Rating S & P menambah profil kredit yang kuat PIF. Rating Moody mengkonfirmasi penilaian kredit baseline PIF dan AA3 jangka panjang mengeluarkan rating dengan pandangan stabil tetap tidak berubah setelah peninjauan periodik, pada bulan September. Fitch Ratings juga menegaskan jangka panjang PIF dan mata uang lokal mengeluarkan peringkat baku di 'A +' dengan pandangan stabil, pada bulan Oktober. articles.originalTitle: PIF secures inaugural S&P A+ credit rating with stable outlook
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Public Investment Fund (PIF) announced on Wednesday that S&P Global Ratings has assigned its inaugural A+ long-term foreign and local currency issuer credit ratings, with a stable outlook. PIF’s existing A-1 short-term rating remains unchanged, with PIF’s ratings in line with those of Saudi Arabia.The A+ rating reflects confidence in PIF’s long-term strategy and its strong financial position. It further adds to PIF’s already strong credit profile, thereby supporting its sustainable funding base and long-term investment strategy.S&P’s assessment highlighted PIF’s diversified funding profile, moderate leverage position and its focus on value realization under PIF’s 2026-2030 strategy, as well as its critical role in driving Saudi Arabia’s economic transformation.PIF’s Head of Capital Finance Strategy Ziyad Alfawzan said: “The inaugural A+ long-term rating from S&P marks an important milestone in the continued development of PIF’s credit profile and our long-term funding plan. PIF holds strong long-term credit ratings from S&P, Moody’s and Fitch, reflecting PIF’s diversified and sustainable funding base and the strength of its financial profile and governance. It further reflects confidence in PIF’s long-term strategy, as we advance the 2026-2030 value realization phase.”The S&P rating adds to PIF’s robust credit profile. Moody’s Ratings confirmed PIF’s aa3 baseline credit assessment and Aa3 long-term issuer rating with a stable outlook remain unchanged following a periodic review, in September. articles.title: Disiksa dalam pengakuan dosa:
articles.description: Disiksa dalam pengakuan dosa: Pada tahun 2021, polisi Israel menangkap seorang pria Palestina yang dikenal sebagai R, yang setelah beberapa putaran penyiksaan, menandatangani dokumen pengakuan untuk kejahatan yang tidak dilakukannya. Dia adalah salah satu dari ratusan orang Palestina yang tampil dalam sebuah laporan oleh Komite Publik Terhadap Penyiksaan di Israel (PCATI) yang menghadapi proses kejahatan atas dasar pengakuan yang diambil di bawah paksaan. Pria itu, yang namanya ditahan karena takut akan pembalasan, menghabiskan berbulan-bulan di penjara sebelum rekaman video menunjukkan dia tidak ada di dekat TKP yang dituduhkan padanya. Sebelum video itu terungkap, R berulang kali mencoba menarik pengakuannya atas kejahatan yang tidak jelas tapi disiksa oleh pejabat Shin Bet bagaimanapun juga. Baca lebih lanjut: Disiksa dalam pengakuan: Laporan mengungkapkan kekerasan interogasi Israel Palestina dibebaskan dari penjara Israel diperiksa oleh petugas medis di Rumah Sakit Al- Aqsa Martir di Deir El- Balah di pusat Jalur Gaza pada 10 April 2025 (Eyad Baba / AFP)
articles.originalTitle: Tortured into confessing: Report exposes abusive Israeli interrogation of Palestinians
articles.originalDescription: Tortured into confessing: Report exposes abusive Israeli interrogation of Palestinians In 2021, Israeli police arrested a Palestinian man known as R, who after multiple rounds of torture, signed a confession document for a crime he did not commit. He is one of hundreds of Palestinians featured in a report by the Public Committee Against Torture in Israel (PCATI) who faced criminal proceedings on the basis of confessions extracted under duress. The man, whose name was withheld for fear of reprisals, spent months in prison before video footage showed he had been nowhere near the scene of the crime he was accused of. Before that video came to light, R repeatedly tried to withdraw his confession to the unspecified crime but was tortured by Shin Bet officials regardless. articles.title: Houthis mengatakan mereka menyerang kilang minyak terbesar Arab Saudi untuk membalas dendam atas serangan mematikan
articles.description: Houthis mengatakan mereka menyerang kilang minyak terbesar di Saudi Arabia untuk membalas dendam atas serangan mematikan di Yaman Houthi gerakan mengklaim bertanggung jawab atas serangan terhadap kilang minyak terbesar Arab Saudi, Ras Tanura, pada hari Rabu, menggambarkan sebagai pembalasan atas serangan ulang Saudi yang telah membunuh sejumlah warga sipil. Juru bicara militer Houthi Yahya Saree mengatakan dalam sebuah pos di X bahwa serangan kilang menyebabkan kebakaran dan membalas dendam untuk "agresi brutal Saudi terhadap negara kita, termasuk menargetkan bus penumpang dan truk warga negara di distrik Al- Maqatirah di Lahij, serta kejahatan lainnya di ibukota, Sanaa, dan pemerintah". Serangan di distrik Lahij awal minggu ini menewaskan setidaknya 26 orang. articles.originalTitle: Houthis say they attacked Saudi Arabia's largest oil refinery in retaliation for deadly strikes
articles.originalDescription: Houthis say they attacked Saudi Arabia's largest oil refinery in retaliation for deadly strikes Yemen's Houthi movement claimed responsibility for an attack on Saudi Arabia's largest oil refinery, Ras Tanura, on Wednesday, describing it as retaliation for repeated Saudi strikes that have killed scores of civilians. Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree said in a post on X that the refinery attack caused fires and came in retaliation for the "brutal Saudi aggression against our country, including its targeting of passenger buses and citizens' trucks in the Al-Maqatirah district of Lahij, as well as other crimes in the capital, Sanaa, and the governorates." The attack in the district of Lahij earlier this week killed at least 26 people. articles.title: Gunung penuh emas Chad yang memegang kunci krisis Libya dan perang Sudan
articles.description: Gunung Chad yang dipenuhi emas yang memegang kunci krisis Libya dan perang Sudan diturunkan oleh koresponden MEE pada Wid, 11 / 25 / 2026 - 14: 23 Sebuah sengketa tambang di kota beberapa ribu orang tersimpan di atap terpencil Sahara telah menjadi terjerat dengan koridor senjata mempertahankan salah satu perang paling mematikan dunia gunung Tibesti berjalan melalui utara Chad ke Libya selatan, dan pulang ke Tubu orang (MEE) Jauh di dalam pegunungan Tibesti utara Chad, di Sahara pusat, kota Miski dikelilingi oleh suksesi dari nevering-wadis. Beberapa keluarga tinggal di atas setiap lembah dan pada bulan Agustus, ketika musim hujan datang, wadi menjadi sungai yang mencuci melalui pegunungan. (Dan apabila hujan telah turun) telah menjadi hujan dan hujan mulai menampakkan sinarnya (dan menjadi hijau) menjadi hijau kembali. Jangkauan vulkanik yang ditandai dengan bebatuan, batu yang kasar, sungai lava dan gunung berapi yang naik ke 3.000 meter, Tibesti, yang berjalan melalui utara Chad melintasi perbatasan ke Libya selatan, kadang-kadang disebut atap Sahara. Gunung-gunung ini adalah rumah bagi Tubu, sebuah komunitas pribumi yang wilayahnya juga termasuk bagian selatan Libya, utara Niger dan bagian barat laut Sudan. Dan lembah yang mengelilingi kota Miski berisi deposito besar dari logam berharga bahwa sepanjang sejarah manusia telah dihargai hampir di atas apa pun: emas. Pegunungan juga dipenuhi dengan antimon, logam berat beracun yang menempatkan ekosistem dari komunitas adat ini dengan resiko tinggi dan juga diekspor dalam jumlah besar. Selama beberapa dekade, emas yang terletak di tempat terpencil ini telah menjadi salah satu driver konflik bersenjata antara Tubu dan Libya, kemudian negara-negara Cina. Sekarang, Tubu menemukan diri mereka terjebak dalam jaringan perang dan perdagangan terlarang yang membentang dari Chad ke Libya, Sudan dan laut ke Emirates Arab, dari mana senjata dan persediaan diterbangkan ke tentara proksi, milisi dan paramiliter. articles.originalTitle: The gold-filled mountains of Chad that hold the key to Libya's crisis and Sudan's war
articles.originalDescription: The gold-filled mountains of Chad that hold the key to Libya's crisis and Sudan's war Submitted by MEE correspondent on Wed, 11/25/2026 - 14:23 A mining dispute in a town of a few thousand people tucked away in the remote roof of the Sahara has become entangled with an arms corridor sustaining one of the world’s deadliest wars The Tibesti mountains run through northern Chad into southern Libya, and are home to the Tubu people (MEE) Off Deep inside the Tibesti mountains of northern Chad, in the central Sahara, the town of Miski sits surrounded by a succession of never-ending wadis. A couple of families live at the top of each of these valleys and in August, when the rainy season comes, the wadis become a river that washes through the mountains. When the rains go, the valleys become green and camels feed on them. A remote volcanic range characterised by rugged, bare rock, rivers of lava and volcanoes that climb to 3,000 metres, the Tibesti, which runs through northern Chad across the border into southern Libya, is sometimes called the roof of the Sahara. These mountains are home to the Tubu, an indigenous community whose territory also includes a part of southern Libya , northern Niger and northwestern Sudan . And the valleys that surround the town of Miski contain vast deposits of a precious metal that throughout human history has been prized almost above anything else: gold. The mountains, too, are filled with antimony, a toxic heavy metal that is putting the ecosystem of this indigenous community at severe risk and is also exported in great quantities. For decades, the gold that sits in this remote place has been one of the drivers of armed conflict between the Tubu and the Libyan, then Chadian states. Now, the Tubu find themselves caught up in a web of warfare and illicit trade that stretches out from Chad into Libya, Sudan and over the sea to the United Arab Emirates , from where arms and supplies are flown to proxy armies, militias and paramilitaries. articles.title: Al- Mushaiti: Investasi sektor swasta di sektor pertanian melampaui SR60 miliar
articles.description: RIYADH - Wakil Menteri Lingkungan, Air dan Pertanian Eng. "Selama 10 tahun terakhir, Dana Pengembangan Pertanian telah memberikan pinjaman melebihi SR40 miliar, setara dengan total yang telah diperpanjang selama lima dekade sebelumnya. Hal ini telah membantu merangsang investasi sektor swasta di pertanian, yang melebihi SR60 miliar", katanya sambil menghadiri Forum Budget 2027 di Riyadh pada hari Rabu. Al- Mushaiti mengatakan bahwa investasi ini telah berkontribusi untuk meningkatkan produksi pertanian dari 6 juta ton pada 2015 menjadi lebih dari 13 juta ton pada tahun 2025, sementara sektor berkontribusi terhadap produk domestik kotor (GDP) naik dari SR54 miliar ke SR124 miliar selama periode yang sama. Wakil menteri menekankan bahwa Arab Saudi sekarang menuai hadiah dari satu dekade prestasi di bawah Saudi Vision 2030. "Kerajaan terus mengejar targetnya melalui model pengembangan yang mengukur kemajuan oleh hasil nyata dan manfaat ekonomi dan sosial yang dialami oleh warga negara", katanya. Al- Mushaiti mencatat bahwa lingkungan, air, dan sistem pertanian telah mencapai tonggak yang signifikan dalam keamanan makanan, keamanan air, dan keberlanjutan lingkungan, dengan dukungan yang murah hati dari kepemimpinan yang bijaksana. Wakil menteri meninjau prestasi kunci lingkungan, air, dan sektor pertanian. Dia menyoroti dampak investasi dan kemitraan pemerintah dengan sektor swasta dalam mempromosikan pengembangan berkelanjutan, meningkatkan efisiensi sumber daya, dan mencapai target nasional. Al- Mushaiti juga mencatat bahwa Program Pengembangan Pertanian yang Terwujud (Saudi Reef) merupakan model efektif untuk menerjemahkan dukungan pemerintah ke manfaat ekonomi dan sosial yang abadi. Lebih dari tujuh tahun, pemerintah menginvestasikan SR3 miliar dalam program ini, menghasilkan kembali ekonomi dari SR10.7 miliar, menyediakan lebih dari 92.000 pendapatan-menghasilkan peluang, dan meningkatkan produksi pedesaan lebih dari 480.000 ton, sejalan dengan keuntungan perbandin
articles.originalTitle: Al-Mushaiti: Private-sector investments in agriculture sector surpass SR60 billion
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Deputy Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture Eng. Mansour Al-Mushaiti said that the agricultural sector is a key pillar of food security and a driver of economic and social development. “Over the past 10 years, the Agricultural Development Fund has provided loans exceeding SR40 billion, equivalent to the total amount it had extended over the preceding five decades. This has helped stimulate private-sector investment in agriculture, which has exceeded SR60 billion,” he said while attending the Budget 2027 Forum in Riyadh on Wednesday.Al-Mushaiti said that these investments had contributed to increasing agricultural production from 6 million tons in 2015 to more than 13 million tons in 2025, while the sector's contribution to gross domestic product (GDP) rose from SR54 billion to SR124 billion over the same period. The deputy minister emphasized that Saudi Arabia is now reaping the rewards of a decade of achievements under Saudi Vision 2030. “The Kingdom continues to pursue its targets through a development model that measures progress by tangible results and the economic and social benefits experienced by citizens,” he said. Al-Mushaiti noted that the environment, water, and agriculture system had achieved significant milestones in food security, water security, and environmental sustainability, with generous support from the wise leadership. The deputy minister reviewed the key achievements of the environment, water, and agriculture sectors. He highlighted the impact of government investments and partnerships with the private sector in promoting sustainable development, improving resource efficiency, and achieving national targets. Al-Mushaiti also noted that the Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) represents an effective model for translating government support into lasting economic and social benefits. articles.title: Menteri Al- Saif: Investasi di Arab Saudi melebihi SR1.3 triliun pada tahun 2025
articles.description: RIYADH - Menteri Investasi Fahad Al- Saif mengatakan bahwa investasi di Arab Saudi melampaui SR1.3 triliun selama 2025, dan diharapkan total tahun ini untuk tetap dalam jangkauan yang sama. Menghadiri diskusi panel di Forum Budget 2027 di Riyadh pada hari Rabu, menteri mengatakan investasi meningkat sebesar 6 persen pada paruh pertama 2026 dibandingkan dengan periode yang sama pada tahun 2025. Al- Saif menegaskan bahwa prioritas pengeluaran yang jelas meningkatkan kepercayaan investor, memungkinkan sektor swasta untuk merencanakan, memperluas, berkontribusi terhadap diversifikasi ekonomi, dan menciptakan peluang kerja bagi warga negara Saudi. Dia mencatat bahwa lima tahun terakhir telah melihat lebih dari SR6 triliun dituangkan ke infrastruktur, menambahkan investasi yang telah meningkat secara memasarkan selama enam bulan terakhir. * * media [2798878] * * Menteri tersebut menggambarkan Arab Saudi sebagai tujuan utama bagi para investor, mengutip prosedur yang dipersingkat di beberapa sektor, termasuk pasokan energi, transportasi dan logistik, telekomunikasi dan layanan teknologi, serta sektor yang menjanjikan seperti pariwisata, yang menarik modal substansial. Menteri mengatakan koordinasi antara investasi dan sektor pariwisata telah menghasilkan perjanjian senilai SR7 miliar dengan 19 investor lokal di enam tujuan. Dia menambahkan bahwa kementerian bekerja untuk memfasilitasi perjalanan investor di Kerajaan, terutama yang lokal, yang mampu menarik modal asing. Dia mengungkapkan bahwa 76 transaksi senilai SR95 miliar diselesaikan pada tahun 2026 di berbagai sektor. articles.originalTitle: Minister Al-Saif: Investments in Saudi Arabia exceed SR1.3 trillion in 2025
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Minister of Investment Fahad Al-Saif said that investments in Saudi Arabia exceeded SR1.3 trillion during 2025, and expected this year’s total to remain within a similar range. Attending a panel discussion at the Budget 2027 Forum in Riyadh on Wednesday, the minister said investment rose by 6 percent in the first half of 2026 compared with the same period in 2025. Al-Saif affirmed that clear spending priorities bolster investor confidence, enabling the private sector to plan, expand, contribute to economic diversification, and create job opportunities for Saudi citizens. He noted that the past five years had seen more than SR6 trillion poured into infrastructure, adding that investment had increased markedly over the last six months. **media[2799878]** The minister described Saudi Arabia as a primary destination for investors, citing streamlined procedures across several sectors, including energy supply, transport and logistics, telecommunications and technology services, as well as promising sectors such as tourism, which is attracting substantial capital. The minister said coordination between the investment and tourism sectors had resulted in agreements worth SR7 billion with 19 local investors across six destinations. He added that the ministry was working to facilitate the journey of investors in the Kingdom, particularly local ones, who are capable of attracting foreign capital.He revealed that 76 deals worth SR95 billion were completed in 2026 across various sectors. The minister also noted that the Kingdom enjoys considerable diversity and competitive advantages across its regions, particularly in coastal areas, which offer attractive opportunities for investment in technology, tourism, and logistics, supported by an integrated telecommunications and digital ecosystem and a comprehensive transport network linking the entire country. articles.title: Jeremy Corbyn dan Rashida Tlaib bergabung dengan politisi dan kelompok hukum mengutuk UM 5 penuntutan
articles.description: Jeremy Corbyn dan Rashida Tlaib bergabung dengan politisi dan kelompok hukum mengutuk Ulam 5 penuntutan yang diajukan oleh Katherine Hearst pada Wed, 11 / 25 / 2026 - 13: 02 Dua huruf yang ditandatangani oleh 26 politisi dan 31 kelompok hukum menuntut 'pembebasan langsung' dari terdakwa di Jerman 'Ulm Five' dari kiri ke kiri ke kanan: Daniel Tatlow--Devally, Zo Hailu, Crow Tricks, Vi Kovarbasic dan Leandra Rollo (disediakan) dari Jeremy Corbyn dan Rashida Tlaib ada di antara lusinan politisi dan organisasi hukum yang mengangkat alarm atas penuntutan dan pengobatan para aktivis pro- Palestina di Jerman. Dua surat dikeluarkan pada hari Rabu, ditandatangani oleh 26 politisi dan 31 kelompok hukum dari seluruh dunia, mengutuk perlakuan lima aktivis yang telah diadakan di pra peradilan selama lebih dari 14 bulan. Daniel Tatlow- Devially, Zo Hailu, Crow Tricks, Vi Kovarbasic dan Leandra Rollo, yang berasal dari Jerman, Spanyol, Irlandia dan Inggris, ditangkap pada 8 September, berikut dugaan breakfast di lokasi perusahaan senjata Israel Elbit Systems di kota Jerman sebelah barat daya Ulm. Dikenal sebagai "Ulm Five", kelompok tersebut dituduh merusak kaca gedung dan menghancurkan peralatan kantor, termasuk komputer, layar dan telepon. Selain biaya pelanggaran dan kerusakan properti, lima yang dituduh "keanggotaan organisasi kriminal", yaitu Palestina Action Jerman, di bawah Bagian 129 dari kode pidana Jerman. Undang-undang biasanya digunakan untuk menargetkan jaringan kejahatan terorganisir dan membawa hukuman potensial hingga lima tahun penjara. Semua terdakwa telah ditahan dalam penahanan pra-peradilan yang berkepanjangan, di mana mereka melaporkan menghadapi kondisi terbatas. Berdasarkan pasal 129, tersangka dapat ditahan selama enam bulan sebelum sidang, meskipun pengacara mengatakan periode ini telah secara signifikan diperpanjang. Dalam surat mereka, pejabat terpilih - termasuk anggota Bundestag Jerman, Parlemen Eropa, Kongres AS, Parlemen Irlandia dan legislatif lain
articles.originalTitle: Jeremy Corbyn and Rashida Tlaib join politicians and legal groups condemning Ulm 5 prosecution
articles.originalDescription: Jeremy Corbyn and Rashida Tlaib join politicians and legal groups condemning Ulm 5 prosecution Submitted by Katherine Hearst on Wed, 11/25/2026 - 13:02 Two letters signed by 26 politicians and 31 legal groups demand the 'immediate release' of defendants in Germany The 'Ulm Five' from left to right: Daniel Tatlow-Devally, Zo Hailu, Crow Tricks, Vi Kovarbasic and Leandra Rollo (supplied) Off Jeremy Corbyn and Rashida Tlaib are among dozens of politicians and legal organisations raising alarm over the prosecution and treatment of pro- Palestine activists in Germany . Two letters issued on Wednesday, signed by 26 politicians and 31 legal groups from across the globe, condemned the treatment of five activists who have been held in pretrial detention for over 14 months. Daniel Tatlow-Devally, Zo Hailu, Crow Tricks, Vi Kovarbasic and Leandra Rollo, who are from Germany, Spain , Ireland and the UK , were arrested on 8 September following an alleged break-in at the premises of Israeli arms firm Elbit Systems in the southwestern German city of Ulm. Known as the “Ulm Five”, the group is accused of damaging the building's glass facade and smashing office equipment, including computers, screens and telephones. In addition to charges of trespass and damage to property, the five are accused of "membership of a criminal organisation", namely Palestine Action Germany, under Section 129 of the German penal code. The legislation is typically used to target organised crime networks and carries a potential sentence of up to five years in prison. All the defendants have been held in prolonged pretrial detention, where they report facing restrictive conditions. Under Section 129, suspects can be held for up to six months before trial, though lawyers say this period has now been significantly extended. articles.title: Raja Salman memperluas Program Akun Warga dan dukungan tambahan selama setahun penuh
articles.description: RIYADH - Penjaga dari Dua Masjid Suci Raja Salman telah memerintahkan perpanjangan Program Akun Warga bersama dengan penyediaan dukungan tambahan kepada penerima selama satu tahun penuh. Keputusan ini sejalan dengan rekomendasi dari Putra Mahkota, Perdana Menteri dan Ketua Dewan Ekonomi dan Urusan Pengembangan Mohammed bin Salman, Badan Pers Saudi dilaporkan pada hari Rabu. Sesuai perintah kerajaan, Program Akun Citizen dan dukungan tambahan akan terus diberikan kepada ahli warisnya sampai akhir tahun 2027. Ini adalah tambahan untuk terus membuka pendaftaran untuk program. Direktif Raja keluar dari kepemimpinan Saudi 's keenness dan perawatan untuk warga Saudi. Arab Saudi meluncurkan Program Akun Warga untuk melindungi keluarga Saudi dari dampak yang diharapkan langsung dan tidak langsung dari berbagai reformasi ekonomi, yang dapat menyebabkan beban tambahan pada masyarakat, itu ditunjukkan.
articles.originalTitle: King Salman extends Citizen Account Program and additional support for a full year
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman has ordered the extension of the Citizen Account Program along with the provision of additional support to its beneficiaries for another full year. This decision was in line with the recommendation of Crown Prince, Prime Minister and Chairman of the Council of Economic and Development Affairs Mohammed bin Salman, the Saudi Press Agency reported on Wednesday. As per the royal order, the Citizen Account Program and additional support will continue to be provided to its beneficiaries through the end of the year 2027. This is in addition to continuing to open the registration for the program. The King’s directive comes out of the Saudi leadership’s utmost keenness and care for the Saudi citizens. Saudi Arabia launched the Citizen Account Program to protect Saudi families from the expected direct and indirect impact of various economic reforms, which may cause an additional burden on society, it was pointed out.

articles.title: Aramco, S- OIL meresmikan proyek Shaheen di Korea
articles.description: DHAHRAN - Saudi Aramco dan anak perusahaan S-OIL meresmikan Proyek Shaheen pada sebuah upacara diadakan di Seoul, ibukota Republik Korea, pada hari Rabu. Proyek ini adalah investasi terbesar di negeri ini, dan peresmian tersebut dihadiri oleh pemimpin bisnis senior dari Arab Saudi dan Korea, sebagai tambahan perwakilan dari industri energi dan bahan kimia. Ini bertepatan dengan ulang tahun ke-50 S-OIL dan merupakan tonggak penting dalam kerjasama strategis 35- tahun antara Aramco dan S-OIL, sebuah hubungan yang dimulai dengan investasi awal dari Aramco S-OIL pada tahun 1991. Presiden Aramco dan CEO Amin H. Nasser berkata: "Angin keras ekonomi dan resiko geopolitik meningkat tidak mengubah pandangan jangka panjang kita tentang investasi strategis. Salah satu contoh yang jelas adalah Shaheen, investasi terbesar kita di Korea, mencerminkan kepercayaan kita pada negara ini dan di wilayah yang akan mendorong permintaan energi masa depan. Investasi seperti Shaheen membangun ketahanan yang dibutuhkan pasar dalam waktu yang tidak pasti. Melalui termal Aramco mentah untuk teknologi kimia, dikerahkan pada skala, proyek akan memperkuat S-OIL internasional kompetisi dan menciptakan lebih banyak nilai dari setiap barel. Bersama-sama, kita diposisikan untuk memenuhi permintaan kenaikan bahan penting untuk industri kunci Asia, dari kendaraan listrik ke semikonduktor. Ketika S-OIL merayakan ulang tahun ke-50, kami sedang membangun yayasan untuk 50 tahun ke depan dan seterusnya." Aramco Downstream President Mohammed Y. Al Qahtani berkata: "Petrokimia sangat penting untuk kompetisi industri secara keseluruhan, dan Shaheen membawa teknologi mutakhir ke wilayah tersebut, membantu posisi Korea sebagai salah satu produsen paling kompetitif di dunia dengan memprioritaskan efisiensi, perbedaan teknologi, dan penambahan nilai. articles.originalTitle: Aramco, S-OIL inaugurate Shaheen project in Korea
articles.originalDescription: DHAHRAN — Saudi Aramco and its subsidiary S-OIL inaugurated the Shaheen Project at a ceremony held in Seoul, capital of the Republic of Korea, on Wednesday. The project is Aramco’s largest investment in the country, and the inauguration was attended by senior government and business leaders from Saudi Arabia and Korea, in addition to representatives of the energy and chemicals industries. It coincides with S-OIL’s 50th anniversary and represents an important milestone in the 35-year strategic partnership between Aramco and S-OIL, a relationship that began with Aramco’s initial S-OIL investment in 1991. Aramco President and CEO Amin H. Nasser said: “Economic headwinds and rising geopolitical risks do not alter our long-term view on strategic investments. One clear example is Shaheen, our largest ever investment in Korea, reflecting our confidence in the country and in the region that will drive future energy demand. Investments like Shaheen build the resilience that markets need in uncertain times. Through Aramco’s thermal crude to chemicals technology, deployed at scale, the project will strengthen S-OIL’s international competitiveness and create more value from every barrel. Together, we are positioned to meet the rising demand for materials essential to Asia’s key industries, from electric vehicles to semiconductors. As S-OIL celebrates its 50th anniversary, we are building the foundation for its next 50 years and beyond.” Aramco Downstream President Mohammed Y. Al Qahtani said: “Petrochemicals are critical to overall industrial competitiveness, and Shaheen brings cutting-edge technology to the region, helping position Korea as one of the world’s most competitive producers by prioritizing efficiency, technological differentiation, and value addition. articles.title: cakupan kesehatan Arab Saudi mencapai 97%, memberikan lebih dari 109 juta layanan di 2026
articles.description: RIYADH - Asisten Menteri Kesehatan Dr Mohammed Al- Abdulaali mengatakan bahwa ekosistem kesehatan di Arab Saudi telah memberikan lebih dari 109 juta layanan di 2026 dan menambahkan 116 proyek, termasuk 15 proyek baru dan pembangunan lebih dari 101 situs. Ringkasan kesehatan penduduk mencapai 97 persen, operasi meningkat menjadi 13.000 per minggu, dan 94,6% dari pasien darurat dirawat dalam waktu empat jam, katanya sambil menangani Forum Budget 2027 di Riyadh pada hari Rabu. Abdulaali meninjau prestasi utama ekosistem kesehatan pada tahun 2026. Dia menyoroti kemajuan dalam meningkatkan akses untuk peduli dan meningkatkan kualitas layanan di bawah Program Transformasi Sektor Kesehatan, bagian dari Saudi Vision 2030. Al- Abdulaali mencatat bahwa indeks pengalaman penerima meningkat lebih dari 89 persen, naik dari 66 persen di 2017, menurut pengukuran internasional independen. Dia menambahkan bahwa hasil motivasi terus bekerja untuk membawa perawatan lebih dekat, meningkatkan layanan, dan menempatkan pencegahan pertama.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia’s health coverage reaches 97%, delivering over 109 million services in 2026
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Assistant Minister of Health for Health Services Dr. Mohammed Al-Abdulaali said that the health ecosystem in Saudi Arabia has delivered more than 109 million services in 2026 and added 116 projects, including 15 new ones and the development of over 101 sites. Health coverage of population clusters reached 97 percent, surgeries rose to 13,000 per week, and 94.6% of emergency patients received care within four hours, he said while addressing the Budget 2027 Forum in Riyadh on Wednesday. Abdulaali reviewed the health ecosystem's main achievements in 2026. He highlighted the progress in improving access to care and raising service quality under the Health Sector Transformation Program, part of Saudi Vision 2030. Al-Abdulaali noted that the beneficiary experience index rose to more than 89 percent, up from 66 percent in 2017, according to an independent international measurement. He added that the results motivate continued work to bring care closer, improve services, and put prevention first.

articles.title: Arab Saudi untuk meluncurkan asisten cerdas untuk setiap warga negara di Q1 2027
articles.description: RIYADH - Menteri Komunikasi dan Teknologi Informasi Abdullah Alswaha mengumumkan rencana untuk meluncurkan asisten cerdas untuk setiap warga negara pada kuartal pertama 2027 melalui Saudi Data dan Authority AI. "Ini akan membiarkan penerima manfaat berinteraksi dengan suara dalam dialek lokal mereka, dengan layanan pemerintah seperti pembaruan paspor, vaksinasi, dan pendaftaran sekolah. Sebuah percobaan awal dengan 500 pengguna akan berkembang menjadi ribuan sebelum peluncuran", katanya sambil berbicara di Forum Budget 2027 di Riyadh pada hari Rabu. * * Media [2799763] * Alswaha mengatakan bahwa Arab Saudi sedang bergerak menuju tujuan peringkat di antara lima negara teratas di dunia dalam kecerdasan buatan (AI), membangun pada prestasinya dalam telekomunikasi dan pemerintahan digital, karena ekonomi digital nya mendekati setengah triliun riyal. Menteri menunjukkan bahwa perdagangan digital antara lembaga dan individu tumbuh 30 persen pada kuartal terakhir untuk mencapai SR100 miliar, dan memuji upaya 420.000 orang Saudi pria dan wanita bekerja di sektor tersebut. Dia mencatat bahwa Kerajaan peringkat keempat secara global dalam indeks pemerintah digital keseluruhan dan pertama dalam lima indikator utama, termasuk layanan pemerintah, melampaui Saudi Vision 2030 target empat tahun lebih cepat dari jadwal. Alswaha bilang Kerajaan berpindah dari digital ke pemerintah berbasis AI-. Platform pemerintah digabung, mengurangi nomor mereka dari 800 ke 450, dan lebih dari 1.800 layanan sekarang tersedia melalui aplikasi "Tawakkhalna". Dia menambahkan bahwa Kerajaan sedang bekerja pada tiga pilar AI: infrastruktur berkembang dan pusat data, memimpin adopsi aplikasi AI, dan meningkatkan persaingan bakat dan perusahaan nasional.
articles.originalTitle: Alswaha: Saudi Arabia to launch smart assistant for every citizen in Q1 2027
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Minister of Communications and Information Technology Abdullah Alswaha announced plans to launch a smart assistant for every citizen in the first quarter of 2027 through the Saudi Data and AI Authority. “It will let beneficiaries interact by voice in their local dialects, with government services such as passport renewal, vaccinations, and school registration. An initial trial with 500 users will expand to thousands before launch,” he said while speaking at the Budget 2027 Forum in Riyadh on Wednesday. **media[2799763]** Alswaha said Saudi Arabia is moving toward its goal of ranking among the world's top five countries in artificial intelligence (AI), building on its achievements in telecommunications and digital government, as its digital economy approaches half a trillion riyals. The minister indicated that digital trade between institutions and individuals grew 30 percent in the last quarter to reach SR100 billion, and praised the efforts of 420,000 Saudi men and women working in the sector. He noted that the Kingdom ranked fourth globally in the overall digital government index and first in five of its main indicators, including government services, surpassing the Saudi Vision 2030 target four years ahead of schedule. Alswaha said the Kingdom is shifting from digital to AI-based government. Government platforms were merged, reducing their number from 800 to 450, and more than 1,800 services are now available through the "Tawakkalna" app. He added that the Kingdom is working on three AI pillars: developing infrastructure and data centers, leading the adoption of AI applications, and enhancing the competitiveness of national talent and companies.

articles.description: RIYADH - Menteri Keuangan Mohammed Aljadan menekankan bahwa keuangan publik Arab Saudi menikmati tingkat fleksibel dan ketahanan dalam menangani perubahan ekonomi dan geopolitik dan tantangan. articles.originalTitle: Al-Jadaan: Non-oil revenues cover 37% of government spending
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Minister of Finance Mohammed Al-Jadaan stressed that Saudi Arabia’s public finances enjoy a high degree of flexibility and resilience in dealing with economic and geopolitical changes and challenges. He stated that non-oil revenues currently cover around 37 percent of total government spending, compared with 16 percent in previous years. “This helps limit the impact of fluctuations in oil revenues on government spending, enhance its stability, and strengthen the government's ability to plan over the medium term,” he said. **media[2799707]** Al-Jadaan made the remarks while speaking at a panel discussion at the Budget 2027 Forum, organized by the Ministry of Finance. The minister said that the Kingdom's institutional capabilities had developed significantly over the past 10 years since the launch of Saudi Vision 2030. This progress has enhanced the government's ability to manage crises and change efficiently, make decisions quickly, analyze various scenarios, and benefit from previous infrastructure investments, strengthening its resilience in the face of shocks. Al-Jadaan noted that the Saudi economy had faced numerous challenges over past decades and had emerged from them stronger. The national economy continues to record growth in non-oil GDP, consumption and private-sector investment despite global and regional challenges, supported by the government's ability to manage crises, address their effects and support the private sector. Al-Jadaan stressed that citizens remain at the top of the government's priorities, alongside providing essential care for residents. He said that caring for people, providing services, improving quality of life, and creating business and employment opportunities are key government priorities, adding that there is no conflict between providing essential services and managing crises. articles.title: Orang Palestina di Gaza menghadapi 'ancaman nyata' terhadap keberadaan mereka, kata kepala hak-hak PBB
articles.description: Warga Palestina di Gaza 'ancaman nyata' terhadap keberadaan mereka, kata kepala pemimpin HAM PBB Volker Turk memperingatkan pada hari Rabu dari risiko kejahatan kekejaman lebih lanjut terhadap Palestina di Gaza dan Bank Barat yang diduduki, mendesak semua negara bagian untuk mengambil tindakan segera untuk mencegah mereka. Turk mengutip pernyataan inflamasi oleh pejabat senior Israel menganjurkan aneksasi, pembersihan etnis dan hukuman kolektif, bersama semakin meluas dan sistematis pelanggaran terhadap Palestina. "Di seluruh masyarakat, dorongan terhadap kebencian dan untuk melakukan pelanggaran yang mengakibatkan kejahatan kejam - kejahatan perang, kejahatan terhadap kemanusiaan dan bahkan genosida - telah mengerikan," katanya dalam pernyataan. Pemimpin hak-hak PBB mengatakan kantornya telah berulang kali memperingatkan bahwa tindakan Israel di Gaza menimbulkan "ancaman nyata terhadap keberadaan terus" Palestina sebagai sebuah kelompok. "Peringatan kami belum diperhatikan, dan kejahatan kejam terus recur," tambahnya.
articles.originalTitle: Palestinians in Gaza face 'real threat' to their existence, says UN rights chief
articles.originalDescription: Palestinians in Gaza face 'real threat' to their existence, says UN rights chief UN human rights chief Volker Turk warned on Wednesday of a growing risk of further atrocity crimes against Palestinians in Gaza and the occupied West Bank, urging all states to take immediate action to prevent them. Turk cited inflammatory statements by senior Israeli officials advocating annexation, ethnic cleansing and collective punishment, alongside increasingly widespread and systematic violations against Palestinians. “Across society, the incitement to hatred and to perpetration of violations amounting to atrocity crimes – war crimes, crimes against humanity and even genocide – has been appalling,” he said in a statement. The UN rights chief said his office had repeatedly warned that Israel’s actions in Gaza posed a “real threat to the continued existence” of Palestinians as a group. “Our warnings have not been heeded, and atrocity crimes continue to recur,” he added.

articles.title: Amnesty mengatakan wanita dan wanita Palestina menanggung akibat genosida Israel
articles.description: Amnesty mengatakan wanita dan anak perempuan Palestina menderita akibat genosida di Israel, Amnesty International mengatakan pada hari Rabu bahwa Israel terus menimbulkan kehancuran bagi wanita dan wanita Palestina di Gaza sebagai bagian dari genosida yang sedang berlangsung, meskipun gencatan senjata Oktober 2025. Dalam laporan baru 135-halaman, kelompok hak-hak mendokumentasikan pembunuhan, maiming, perpindahan paksa, penahanan yang melanggar hukum dan kelaparan perempuan dan anak perempuan, serta penyangkalan disengaja kesehatan penting, termasuk perawatan reproduksi, antara Oktober 2023 dan Oktober 2026. "Laporan baru ini memancarkan cahaya pada dimensi gender yang mendalam dari genosida Israel, menyediakan rincian baru tentang kejahatan brutal yang ditimbulkan pada wanita dan gadis-gadis yang terus menghancurkan hidup mereka dan menyebabkan penderitaan meskipun begitu-disebut gencatan senjata", kata Agnes Callaard, Sekretaris jenderal Amnesty.
articles.originalTitle: Amnesty says Palestinian women and girls bear crushing toll of Israel’s genocide
articles.originalDescription: Amnesty says Palestinian women and girls bear crushing toll of Israel’s genocide Amnesty International said on Wednesday that Israel continues to inflict devastating harm on Palestinian women and girls in Gaza as part of its ongoing genocide, despite the October 2025 ceasefire. In a new 135-page report , the rights group documented the killing, maiming, forced displacement, unlawful detention and starvation of women and girls, as well as the deliberate denial of essential healthcare, including reproductive care, between October 2023 and October 2026. “This new report sheds light on the profound gendered dimensions of Israel’s genocide, providing new details about the brutal harms inflicted on women and girls that continue to devastate their lives and cause agonizing suffering despite the so-called ceasefire,” said Agnes Callamard, Amnesty’s secretary general.

articles.title: Menteri pertahanan Saudi bertemu komandan CENTCOM, mendiskusikan keamanan daerah dengan Bahraini dan pejabat Belanda
articles.description: RIYADH - Saudi Menteri Pertahanan Khalid bin Salman bertemu dengan Komando Pusat AS (CENTCOM) Komandan di Riyadh dan mengadakan telepon terpisah dengan pejabat senior dari Bahrain dan Belanda untuk mendiskusikan kerjasama pertahanan, pengembangan regional dan keamanan dan stabilitas. Selama pertemuannya dengan Laksamana Brad Cooper, Pangeran Khalid membahas prospek untuk kerjasama pertahanan bilateral, cara untuk mencapai keamanan, stabilitas dan perdamaian di wilayah tersebut, dan masalah kepentingan bersama. Dalam panggilan telepon dengan Penasehat Keamanan Nasional Bahrain dan Sekretaris - Jenderal Dewan Pertahanan Agung Letnan Jenderal Sheikh Nasser bin Hamad Al Khalifa, kedua belah pihak mendiskusikan serangan teroris terhadap Arab Saudi dan serangan keji Iran terhadap Bahrain. Mereka menegaskan solidaritas mereka dalam langkah-langkah yang diambil untuk melindungi keamanan dan stabilitas kedua negara. Dalam panggilan telepon yang terpisah dengan Wakil Perdana Menteri Belanda dan Menteri Pertahanan Dilan Yeşilg-Zeberius, Pangeran Khalid meninjau hubungan pertahanan bilateral dan membahas pengembangan daerah, terutama serangan teroris Houthi melawan Kerajaan dan implikasi mereka untuk keamanan dan stabilitas.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi defense minister meets CENTCOM commander, discusses regional security with Bahraini and Dutch officials
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Minister of Defense Prince Khalid bin Salman met with U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) Commander in Riyadh and held separate phone calls with senior officials from Bahrain and the Netherlands to discuss defense cooperation, regional developments and security and stability. During his meeting with Admiral Brad Cooper Cooper, Prince Khalid discussed prospects for bilateral defense cooperation, ways to achieve security, stability and peace in the region, and matters of mutual interest. In a phone call with Bahrain’s National Security Advisor and Secretary-General of the Supreme Council of Defense Lieutenant General Sheikh Nasser bin Hamad Al Khalifa, the two sides discussed Houthi terrorist attacks against Saudi Arabia and Iran’s heinous attacks against Bahrain. They affirmed their solidarity in the measures being taken to protect the security and stability of both countries. In a separate phone call with Dutch Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Defense Dilan Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Prince Khalid reviewed bilateral defense relations and discussed regional developments, particularly the ongoing Houthi terrorist attacks against the Kingdom and their implications for security and stability.

articles.title: Arab Saudi menargetkan SR550 miliar dalam pengeluaran turis, 200.000 kamar hotel tambahan pada 2030
articles.description: RIYADH - Arab Saudi menargetkan SR550 miliar pengeluaran turis pada tahun 2030, dengan 200.000 kamar hotel tambahan sudah dalam pembangunan, Menteri Turisme Ahmed Al- Khateeb mengatakan. Berbicara di Forum Budget 2027 di Riyadh pada hari Rabu, Al- Khateeb mengatakan pengeluaran turis telah meningkat dari sekitar SR120 miliar di 2019 ke SR304 miliar di 2025. Menteri menyoroti kemajuan Kerajaan terhadap mencapai target wisata yang ditetapkan oleh Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Mohammed bin Salman, termasuk menarik 150 juta wisatawan, menciptakan pekerjaan dan mencapai SR550 miliar pengeluaran wisatawan pada 2030. Al- Khateeb mencatat bahwa jumlah wisatawan telah meningkat dari sekitar 90 juta di tahun 2019 sampai 123 juta tahun 2025, mengekspresikan kepercayaan diri bahwa Kingdom berada di jalur untuk mencapai 2030 target. Menteri ini juga menyoroti ekspansi sektor keramahan Arab Saudi, mencatat peluang yang diciptakan selama beberapa tahun terakhir telah menghasilkan lebih dari 500 hotel yang beroperasi, menyediakan lebih dari 100.000 kamar di berbagai wilayah Kerajaan. Dia mengungkapkan bahwa Arab Saudi berencana untuk menambahkan 200.000 kamar hotel lain pada tahun 2030, menekankan bahwa ruangan ini sudah dalam pembangunan. Menggambarkan laju ekspansi di sektor perhotelan, Al- Khateeb mengatakan bahwa Arab Saudi hanya memiliki satu hotel milik merek hotel tertentu selama 30 tahun, sementara 10 hotel di bawah merek yang sama sekarang sedang dibangun.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia targets SR550 billion in tourist spending, 200,000 additional hotel rooms by 2030
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia is targeting SR550 billion in tourist spending by 2030, with 200,000 additional hotel rooms already under construction, Minister of Tourism Ahmed Al-Khateeb said. Speaking at the Budget 2027 Forum in Riyadh on Wednesday, Al-Khateeb said tourist spending had risen from approximately SR120 billion in 2019 to SR304 billion in 2025. The minister highlighted the Kingdom's progress toward achieving tourism targets set by Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman, including attracting 150 million tourists, creating jobs and reaching SR550 billion in tourist spending by 2030. Al-Khateeb noted that the number of tourists had increased from approximately 90 million in 2019 to 123 million in 2025, expressing confidence that the Kingdom was on track to achieve its 2030 targets. The minister also highlighted the expansion of Saudi Arabia's hospitality sector, noting that opportunities created over the past several years had resulted in more than 500 hotels coming into operation, providing over 100,000 rooms across various regions of the Kingdom. He revealed that Saudi Arabia plans to add another 200,000 hotel rooms by 2030, emphasizing that these rooms are already under construction. Illustrating the pace of expansion in the hospitality sector, Al-Khateeb said that Saudi Arabia had only one hotel belonging to a particular hotel brand for 30 years, while 10 hotels under the same brand are now being built.

articles.title: Arab Saudi mengidentifikasi $1 triliun dalam peluang investasi infrastruktur selama dekade berikutnya
articles.description: RIYADH - Arab Saudi telah mengidentifikasi peluang investasi infrastruktur senilai sekitar $1 triliun selama delapan sampai 10 tahun ke depan, Menteri Ekonomi dan Perencanaan Faisal Alisha mengatakan. Berbicara di Forum Budget 2027 di Riyadh pada hari Rabu, Alishad menjelaskan bahwa peluang tersebut diidentifikasikan melalui studi selama dua tahun, di antara tumbuh kepentingan internasional di sektor infrastruktur Kingdom. Alishals mencatat bahwa infrastruktur telah muncul sebagai kelas aset utama secara global, dengan aset di bawah manajemen mencapai $1,6 triliun. Dia menghubungkan ketertarikan pada infrastruktur Saudi, terutama tahun ini, pada lokasi geografis strategis Kerajaan dan dampak infrastruktur yang meluas melampaui ekonomi nasional dengan ekonomi global. Menteri mengungkapkan bahwa diskusi sedang berlangsung dengan investor yang tertarik, mengungkapkan keyakinan bahwa keterlibatan ini akan diterjemahkan ke dalam investasi berkualitas tinggi di Kingdom. Alishals juga menyoroti peran dari Dana Infrastruktur Nasional dalam menarik investasi swasta-sektor, mencatat bahwa dana tersebut telah berkomitmen SR10.5 miliar untuk proyek yang dinilai di SR60 miliar dalam jangka pendek pendirian. Dia menjelaskan bahwa untuk setiap riyal dialokasikan oleh pemerintah melalui dana, lebih dari empat riyal tertarik dari sektor swasta dan investor.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia identifies $1 trillion in infrastructure investment opportunities over next decade
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia has identified infrastructure investment opportunities worth approximately $1 trillion over the next eight to 10 years, Minister of Economy and Planning Faisal Alibrahim said. Speaking at the Budget 2027 Forum in Riyadh on Wednesday, Alibrahim explained that the opportunities were identified through a two-year study, amid growing international interest in the Kingdom's infrastructure sector. Alibrahim noted that infrastructure has emerged as a major asset class globally, with assets under management reaching $1.6 trillion. He attributed the growing interest in Saudi infrastructure, particularly this year, to the Kingdom's strategic geographical location and the impact of its infrastructure extending beyond the national economy to the global economy. The minister revealed that discussions are underway with interested investors, expressing confidence that these engagements would translate into high-quality investments in the Kingdom. Alibrahim also highlighted the role of the National Infrastructure Fund in attracting private-sector investment, noting that the fund had committed SR10.5 billion to projects valued at SR60 billion within a short period of its establishment. He explained that for every riyal allocated by the government through the fund, more than four riyals were attracted from the private sector and investors.

articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia’s trade surplus surges 74.5% in September as merchandise exports hit SR115 billion
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia’s merchandise trade surplus surged by 74.5 percent year-on-year in September 2026, according to the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT). The authority’s report showed that merchandise exports rose by 14.2 percent to approximately SR115 billion, while imports declined by 4.3 percent to around SR74 billion. Oil exports increased by 25.6 percent, raising their share of total merchandise exports from 68.6 percent in September 2025 to 75.4 percent in September 2026. Meanwhile, non-oil exports, including re-exports, declined by 10.8 percent, while national non-oil exports, excluding re-exports, fell by 4.6 percent. Re-exports decreased by 20.1 percent, driven by a 67.6 percent decline in re-exports of machinery, electrical equipment and their parts, which accounted for 23.7 percent of total re-exports. The ratio of non-oil exports, including re-exports, to imports fell from 41.1 percent to 38.3 percent year-on-year. Plastics, rubber and their articles accounted for 22 percent of total non-oil exports, despite a year-on-year decline of 3.8 percent. Chemical products and allied industries followed, accounting for 19.6 percent of non-oil exports and recording a decline of 23.3 percent. Machinery, electrical equipment and their parts accounted for the largest share of merchandise imports at 25.3 percent,followed by transportation equipment and parts at 11.8 percent. Imports of the two categories declined by 20.7 percent and 15 percent, respectively. South Korea was the Kingdom’s largest merchandise export destination, accounting for 18.9 percent of total exports, followed by India at 14.3 percent and China at 12.9 percent. China ranked first among Saudi Arabia’s merchandise import sources, accounting for 24.9 percent of total imports, followed by the United States at 8.2 percent and Egypt at 6.2 percent. articles.title: Update pagi
articles.description: Pagi pembaruan Selamat pagi pembaca Mata Timur Tengah, Berikut adalah perkembangan terbaru: Sebuah serangan Israel di sebuah apartemen di Gaza City telah membunuh seorang pejabat keamanan Palestina senior bersama istri dan dua putrinya, berusia 13 dan 15 tahun. Menurut Departemen Dalam Negeri, pria itu diidentifikasi sebagai direktur Internal Security Service di Utara Gaza, Muhammad Majid Abu al- Awf, 47. Ini menandai pembunuhan kedua dari seorang pejabat keamanan di Gaza dalam waktu kurang dari 24 jam, dengan serangan sebelumnya membunuh direktor- Jenderal Layanan Keamanan Dalam Negeri, Naim Mohammed Abu Nahl. Wakil Presiden pertama Iran Mohammad Reza Aref mengatakan bahwa Teheran tidak peduli tentang blokade Angkatan Laut AS, kantor berita Tasnim yang sedang resmi. Dia menunjukkan ketergantungan diri negara dengan peningkatan izin kargo melalui non-selatan perbatasan dan menambahkan bahwa cadangan barang strategis tetap kuat. Angkatan Laut Garda Revolusi Islam Iran mengatakan bahwa dua kapal tanker minyak di pesisir selatan dan timur Selat Hormuz mengalami ledakan. "Tangker ini, percaya mereka diam-diam mencoba untuk melewati Selat palsu rute Hormuz, dicegah dari melewati ranjau laut, menyebabkan ledakan besar dan api", katanya dalam sebuah pernyataan. Juru bicara Saudi- dipimpin koalisi mengatakan dalam sebuah pos di X bahwa itu menargetkan "kemampuan operasional" di pelabuhan Hodeidah Yaman. Selain itu, Turki al- Maliki menambahkan bahwa sejumlah target di utara Saada dan pemerintah Amran hancur. Koalisi Saudi- dipimpin mengatakan hal itu dicegat dan menghancurkan empat drone di Ras Tanura, terletak di Arab Saudi Timur Provinsi. Juru bicara koalisi Turki al- Maliki menunjukkan bahwa sejumlah fragmen telah jatuh sebagai hasil dari interception, tanpa korban dilaporkan dalam penilaian awal. polling AS menunjukkan persetujuan Trump pada 37 persen, dengan ketidaksetujuan yang kuat atas penanganan perang Iran.
articles.originalTitle: Morning update
articles.originalDescription: Morning update Good morning Middle East Eye readers, Here are the latest developments: An Israeli attack on an apartment in Gaza City has killed a senior Palestinian security official alongside his wife and two daughters, aged 13 and 15. According to the interior ministry, the man was identified as the director of the Internal Security Service in northern Gaza, Muhammad Majid Abu al-Awf, 47. This marks the second killing of a security official in Gaza in less than 24 hours, with the previous attack killing director-general of the Internal Security Service, Naim Mohammed Abu Nahl. Iran's First Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref said that Tehran is not concerned about the US naval blockade, the semi-official Tasnim news agency reported. He indicated the country's self-reliance with the increase of cargo clearance through its non-southern borders and added that reserves of strategic goods remain strong. Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Navy said that two "offending" oil tankers on the southern and eastern coasts of the Strait of Hormuz suffered explosions. "These tankers, believing they were secretly trying to pass through the fake Strait of Hormuz route, were prevented from passing by naval mines, causing a massive explosion and fire," it said in a statement. The Saudi-led coalition's spokesperson said in a post on X that it targeted "operational capabilities" at Yemen's Hodeidah port. Additionally, Turki al-Maliki added that a number of targets in northern Yemen's Saada and Amran governorates were destroyed. The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed four drones in Ras Tanura, located in Saudi Arabia’s Eastern Province. The coalition's spokesperson Turki al-Maliki indicated that a number of fragments had fallen as a result of the interception, with no casualties reported in the initial assessment. articles.originalTitle: Commerce Ministry conducts 13,954 inspections to verify compliance with discount regulations
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Ministry of Commerce conducted 13,954 inspection visits across the Kingdom during November to verify establishments’ compliance with regulations governing discounts and promotional offers. The inspections covered markets and shopping centers across all regions of the Kingdom, focusing on the validity of discount permits, their display to consumers, and the accuracy of promotional offers and advertised discount percentages. **media[2799549]** The ministry also verified that establishments displayed prices before and after discounts through price tags or electronic price readers and clearly disclosed their exchange and return policies. The ministry urged consumers to verify the legality and validity of commercial discounts by scanning the barcode displayed on discount permits. The barcode allows consumers to access details about the type, percentage and duration of discounts, as well as information about the establishment.

articles.title: Menteri Luar Negeri AS, Mesir dan Bahrain mengutuk serangan Houthi dengan Saudi FM
articles.description: RIYADH - Menteri Luar Negeri Pangeran Faisal bin Farhan diadakan pada hari Rabu panggilan telepon dengan US Sekretaris Negara Marco Rubio. Selama panggilan, mereka mengutuk serangan teroris milisi Houthi terhadap warga sipil, infrastruktur sipil, dan fasilitas energi di Kingdom. Mereka menekankan pentingnya memastikan kebebasan navigasi dalam Selat Hormuz dan Bab sal- Mandab Selat. Rubio dan Pangeran Faisal membahas upaya untuk membangun keamanan dan perdamaian di Sudan, Lebanon, dan wilayah yang lebih luas, dan menegaskan komitmen mereka untuk melanjutkan tindakan bersama untuk mendukung stabilitas. Pangeran Faisal bin Farhan menerima dua panggilan telepon terpisah dari Menteri Luar Negeri Mesir, Kerjasama Internasional, dan Mesir Expatriates Dr Badar Abdelatty dan Bahraini Menteri Luar Negeri Dr Abdullatif bin Rashid Al Zayani. Selama panggilan, para menteri mendiskusikan perkembangan regional dan mengutuk teroris milisi Houthi yang terus menyerang warga sipil dan warga sipil objek di Arab Saudi dan Yaman. Mereka berusaha untuk mengurangi ketegangan yang meningkat dan meningkatkan keamanan daerah dan stabilitas.
articles.originalTitle: Foreign ministers of US, Egypt and Bahrain condemn Houthi attacks in call with Saudi FM
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Faisal bin Farhan held on Wednesday a phone call with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio.During the call, they condemned the terrorist Houthi militia's attacks on civilians, civilian infrastructure, and energy facilities in the Kingdom. They stressed the importance of ensuring freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab Strait. Rubio and Prince Faisal discussed efforts to establish security and peace in Sudan, Lebanon, and the wider region, and affirmed their commitment to continued joint action to support stability. Prince Faisal bin Farhan received two separate phone calls from Egyptian Minister of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation, and Egyptian Expatriates Dr. Badr Abdelatty and Bahraini Minister of Foreign Affairs Dr. Abdullatif bin Rashid Al Zayani. During the calls, the ministers discussed regional developments and condemned the terrorist Houthi militia's continued attacks on civilians and civilian objects in Saudi Arabia and Yemen. They alsoreviewed efforts to de-escalate tensions and enhance regional security and stability.

articles.title: Watch: Gaza menyatakan peringatan meningitis sebagai pelayanan kesehatan menyalahkan pembatasan Israel
articles.description: Perhatikan: Gaza menyatakan peringatan meningitis saat menteri kesehatan menyalahkan pembatasan kesehatan Israel yang telah mengeluarkan "peringatan epidemiologi" di seluruh wilayah, memperingatkan bahwa "mengejutkan" peningkatan infeksi meningitis membuat ratusan ribu nyawa terancam. Menteri mendesak Organisasi Kesehatan Dunia dan Unicef untuk meluncurkan respon darurat. Dr Nidal Ghunaim, wakil direktur umum kesehatan primer untuk kesehatan publik, dilaporkan 272 kasus pada bulan Oktober. Dia menggambarkan angka itu lebih dari delapan kali rata-rata bulanan biasa dari 30 sampai 50. Meningitis telah membunuh 15 orang tahun ini, Ghunaim mengatakan, termasuk lima selama lonjakan dari Agustus sampai Oktober. Departemen ini menggambarkan wabah ini sebagai "hasil yang tak terelakkan dari kehancuran infrastruktur, kepadatan tempat penampungan, pencampuran air minum dengan limbah, dan bencana yang terjadi karena banjir akibat hujan". Departemen Kesehatan Gaza telah mengeluarkan peringatan epidemiologi atas lonjakan "mengejutkan" pada infeksi meningitis, peringatan bahwa ratusan ribu nyawa terancam, terutama anak-anak. Menteri meminta respon darurat. https: / / t.co / imC1ibBbYr - Middle East Eye (@ MiddleEastEye) November 24, 2026
articles.originalTitle: Watch: Gaza declares meningitis alert as health ministry blames Israeli restrictions
articles.originalDescription: Watch: Gaza declares meningitis alert as health ministry blames Israeli restrictions Gaza’s health ministry has issued an "epidemiological alert" across the territory, warning that a "shocking" increase in meningitis infections puts hundreds of thousands of lives at risk, particularly children. The ministry urged the World Health Organization and Unicef to launch an emergency response. Dr Nidal Ghunaim, deputy director general of primary healthcare for public health, reported 272 cases in October. He described the figure as more than eight times the usual monthly average of 30 to 50. Meningitis has killed 15 people this year, Ghunaim said, including five during the surge from August to October. The ministry described the outbreak as an "inevitable result of the destruction of infrastructure, overcrowding of shelters, mixing of drinking water with sewage, and the disaster being exacerbated by flooding due to rain". Gaza’s health ministry has issued an epidemiological alert over a “shocking” surge in meningitis infections, warning that hundreds of thousands of lives are at risk, particularly children. articles.originalTitle: Ministry of Tourism makes 5 digital services available through Tawakkalna App
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Tourism has made five digital services available through the unified national application "Tawakkalna," in a move aimed at strengthening digital integration and facilitating beneficiaries' access to tourism sector services. It’s objective is to improve their experience and enhancing service delivery efficiency in line with the development taking place in the Kingdom's tourism sector.The move is part of the ministry's efforts to align its digital services with the Digital Government Authority's directions and strengthen integration with national platforms, expanding access channels for tourism sector services and facilitating their use. The services made available through the Tawakkalna app include applying for a tour guide license; the Ministry of Tourism's licenses and applications; tour guiding training; viewing training applications and certificates issued by the ministry; and checking the list of individuals and entities licensed by the Ministry of Tourism.The services available through Tawakkalna are integrated with the Tourism Platform, launched by the ministry as part of its efforts to develop an integrated digital system for tourism sector services. articles.title: Menteri Al- Saif: pertumbuhan anggaran berkelanjutan, meningkatkan kompetisi investasi
articles.description: RIYADH - Menteri Investasi Fahad Al- Saif mengatakan anggaran negara untuk fiskal tahun 2027 mencerminkan komitmen kepemimpinan untuk memajukan tujuan pembangunan Saudi Vision 2030. Hal ini juga mendukung upaya untuk mengubah basis produksi ekonomi nasional dan meningkatkan kontribusi sektor swasta. Al- Saif menyoroti kemampuan ekonomi Saudi untuk mempertahankan stabilitas dan mempertahankan pertumbuhan di tengah perubahan ekonomi global dan geopolitik, mencerminkan kekuatan fondasinya. Dia menambahkan bahwa ketahanan ini memperkuat kepercayaan investor dengan kemampuan mereka untuk mempertahankan dan memperluas bisnis mereka di Arab Saudi. "Kejernihan pengeluaran prioritas membantu sektor swasta merencanakan investasinya dan memperluas bisnisnya", kata menteri. "Di ekosistem investasi, kami bekerja bersama mitra kami untuk menciptakan kesempatan bagi investor lokal dan internasional dan mengubahnya menjadi proyek-proyek produktif yang berkontribusi untuk mentransfer pengetahuan dan teknologi, mengembangkan konten dan rantai nilai lokal, dan menciptakan pekerjaan di berbagai daerah di Kingdom". Al-Saif menunjuk ke indikator Arab Saudi memperluas basis investasi. Investasi langsung asing mengalir mencapai sekitar SR159 miliar pada tahun 2025, naik 33,5%, sementara tetap kotor formasi modal dibatasi sekitar SR1.4 triliun, setara dengan 28,4% produk domestik kotor (PDB). Dia menegaskan bahwa ekosistem investasi bekerja untuk memperkuat lingkungan investasi melalui ekonomi, legislatif, dan reformasi regulasi dan peningkatan layanan bagi investor. Hal ini juga berusaha untuk memungkinkan sektor swasta untuk memperluas investasi bernilai tinggi, sehingga meningkatkan persaingan Arab Saudi dan mendukung pertumbuhan ekonomi berkelanjutan.
articles.originalTitle: Minister Al-Saif : Budget sustains growth, enhances investment competitiveness
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH —Minister of Investment Fahad Al-Saif said the state budget for fiscal year 2027 reflects the leadership’s commitment to advancing the development goals of Saudi Vision 2030. It also supports efforts to diversify the national economy’s production base and increase the private sector’s contribution.Al-Saif highlighted the Saudi economy’s ability to maintain stability and sustain growth amid global economic and geopolitical changes, reflecting the strength of its foundations. He added that this resilience reinforces investors’ confidence in their ability to maintain and expand their businesses in Saudi Arabia. “The clarity of spending priorities helps the private sector plan its investments and expand its businesses," the minister said. “At the investment ecosystem, we are working with our partners to create opportunities for local and international investors and turn them into productive projects that contribute to transferring knowledge and technology, developing local content and value chains, and creating jobs across various regions of the Kingdom."Al-Saif pointed to indicators of Saudi Arabia’s expanding investment base. Foreign direct investment inflows reached around SR159 billion in 2025, up 33.5%, while gross fixed capital formation totaled around SR1.4 trillion, equivalent to 28.4% of gross domestic product (GDP).He affirmed that the investment ecosystem is working to strengthen the investment environment through economic, legislative, and regulatory reforms and improved services for investors. It also seeks to enable the private sector to expand its high-value investments, thereby enhancing Saudi Arabia’s competitiveness and supporting sustainable economic growth.
