articles.originalTitle: Exclusive: Guatemala circulates proposal to curb ICC powers in line with US-Israeli demands
articles.originalDescription: Exclusive: Guatemala circulates proposal to curb ICC powers in line with US-Israeli demands Submitted by Sondos Asem on Sat, 11/21/2026 - 18:15 The Latin American country pitched the idea to diplomats in The Hague despite rights advocates warning against attempts to curb the court's mission Donald Trump speaks as Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio listen during a news briefing in the White House on 20 November 2026 (AFP) Off Guatemala has circulated a proposal to member states of the International Criminal Court (ICC) that closely echoed demands made by the United States and Israel to severely restrict the court's powers, Middle East Eye can reveal. The three-page paper was submitted at a closed-door retreat for ambassadors from ICC member states in The Hague on 18 November, less than two weeks before the court's Assembly of States Parties (ASP) opens its annual session. The proposal advocated for dialogue with the US over curbing the ICC's ability to pursue cases involving nationals of countries that aren't members of the court, such as the US, Israel and Russia. MEE understands that Washington's G7 allies, including the UK, Germany and Italy, expressed a readiness to discuss similar proposals with the US but were reluctant to advocate the idea publicly. As a result, Guatemala, a Latin American country allied with Israel and the US, decided to take the lead and draft the proposal. The document, seen by MEE, reflects Washington's longstanding opposition to the prosecution of Israeli leaders and the court's ability to also prosecute US officials for crimes committed on the territory of member states. The paper floats requiring consent from a suspect's country of nationality even when the alleged crimes took place on the territory of an ICC member state. articles.title: Lebih dari 45 juta transaksi elektronik pada bulan Oktober.
articles.description: RIYADH - Kementerian Dalam Negeri elektronik Absher telah memproses total 45.168.522 transaksi elektronik untuk penerima selama Oktober. Melalui platform Absher Individuals, transaksi total mencapai 42.607.799, dan ini termasuk 33,989.242 dokumen dilihat melalui dompet dokumen digital, yang dapat diakses oleh warga, warga, dan pengunjung melalui aplikasi Absher. Sementara itu, platform bisnis Absher merekam 2.560,723 transaksi. Direktorat Umum Keamanan Umum diproses 3.539.011 transaksi, termasuk 3.400,356 oleh Direktorat Umum lalu lintas, 2.328.379 oleh General Directorat Passport, dan 450,714 oleh Departemen Dalam Negeri Status Badan Sipil. Melalui platform Absher Individuals, 108.073 laporan dikeluarkan menggunakan layanan Laporan Absher, sementara 2.100 pertanyaan umum terkait dengan sidik jari diproses. Perlu dicatat bahwa ID digital yang terpadu dikeluarkan oleh Kementerian Dalam Negeri melalui platform Absher memungkinkan warga, penduduk, dan pengunjung untuk mengakses layanan yang disediakan oleh berbagai sektor pelayanan dengan mudah dan aman melalui platform elektronik: Individuals Absher, Businesses, dan Pemerintah Absher. Mereka juga memfasilitasi akses ke layanan yang ditawarkan oleh pemerintah dan swasta entitas melalui National Unified Access Portal Hafath.
articles.originalTitle: Absher carries out over 45 million electronic transactions in October
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Interior’s electronic platform Absher has processed a total of 45,168,522 electronic transactions for beneficiaries during October.Through the Absher Individuals platform, total transactions reached 42,607,799, and these include 33,989,242 document viewings through the digital document wallet, which is accessible to citizens, residents, and visitors via the Absher application. Meanwhile, the Absher Businesses platform recorded 2,560,723 transactions.The General Directorate of Public Security processed 3,539,011 transactions, including 3,400,356 by the General Directorate of Traffic, 2,328,379 by the General Directorate of Passports, and 450,714 by the Ministry of Interior’s Civil Status Agency. Through the Absher Individuals platform, 108,073 reports were issued using the Absher Reports service, while 2,100 general inquiries related to fingerprinting were processed.It is noteworthy that the unified digital IDs issued by the Ministry of Interior through the Absher platform enable citizens, residents, and visitors to access services provided by the ministry’s various sectors easily and securely through its electronic platforms: Absher Individuals, Absher Businesses, and Absher Government. They also facilitate access to services offered by government and private entities through the National Unified Access Portal Nafath.

articles.title: Arab Saudi memperketat peraturan penitipan anak dengan standar keselamatan stricter, lisensi aturan
articles.description: RIYADH - Arab Saudi diperbarui peraturan untuk pusat pemeliharaan anak swasta memperkenalkan standar keselamatan stricter, tiga hari lisensi dan hukuman sampai pembatalan lisensi untuk pelanggaran. Kementerian Sumber Daya Manusia dan Pengembangan Sosial mengumumkan Amandemen pada hari Senin untuk meningkatkan kualitas pelayanan dan perlindungan anak. Berdasarkan peraturan terbaru, lisensi harus dikeluarkan dalam waktu tiga hari setelah semua persyaratan terpenuhi. Amandemen juga merevisi standar fasilitas, peralatan, kapasitas, staf dan keamanan. Peraturan menetapkan anak-anak terbaru - untuk - rasio pengasuh berdasarkan kelompok usia, bersama kualifikasi dan pengalaman persyaratan untuk staf. Pusat perawatan anak harus menerapkan kebijakan meliputi perlindungan anak, prosedur darurat, keluhan, komunikasi orangtua, nutrisi, pengembangan karyawan dan pembayaran dan pengaturan pengembalian uang. Pusat juga diperlukan untuk menyediakan orang tua dengan laporan harian pada anak-anak mereka dan penilaian bulanan keterampilan yang diperoleh. Amandemen memberikan persyaratan tambahan untuk mengakomodasi anak-anak dengan cacat, termasuk fasilitas yang dapat diakses, peralatan bantu dan personil yang memenuhi syarat. Updated oversight measures prosedur untuk mengatasi pelanggaran dan tenggat waktu untuk tindakan perbaikan, dengan hukuman berkisar dari peringatan dan suspensi operasional sampai pembatalan lisensi. Menteri mengatakan perubahan yang bertujuan untuk memperkuat kesesuaian regulasi, meningkatkan layanan penitipan anak dan menyediakan lingkungan yang lebih aman yang mendukung perkembangan anak-anak.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia tightens childcare regulations with stricter safety standards, licensing rules
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia's updated regulations for private childcare centers introduce stricter safety standards, three-day licensing and penalties of up to license revocation for violations. The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development announced the amendments on Monday to improve service quality and child protection. Under the updated regulations, licenses must be issued within three working days once all requirements are met. The amendments also revise standards for facilities, equipment, capacity, staffing and safety. The regulations establish updated child-to-caregiver ratios based on age groups, alongside qualification and experience requirements for staff. Childcare centers must implement policies covering child protection, emergency procedures, complaints, parental communication, nutrition, employee development and payment and refund arrangements. Centers are also required to provide parents with daily reports on their children and monthly assessments of acquired skills. The amendments introduce additional requirements for accommodating children with disabilities, including accessible facilities, assistive equipment and qualified personnel. Updated oversight measures establish procedures for addressing violations and deadlines for corrective action, with penalties ranging from warnings and operational suspensions to license revocation. The ministry said the changes aim to strengthen regulatory compliance, improve childcare services and provide safer environments that support children's development.

articles.title: Update pagi
articles.description: Pagi pembaruan Selamat pagi pembaca Mata Timur Tengah, Berikut adalah terbaru: Juru bicara Kementerian Luar Negeri Iran Esmaeil Baqaei mengatakan bahwa Teheran dapat "bertindak sangat cepat" untuk membuka kembali Selat Hormuz, diberikan bahwa AS bersekongkol dengan tuntutan negara. "Iran tetap teguh dalam menghormati komitmennya dan akan memenuhi mereka secepat mungkin, menyediakan kondisi pihak lain yang relevan", kata Baqaui. Perdana Menteri Israel Benjamin Netanyahu mendesak Trump untuk menyerang Iran "sesegera mungkin", menurut penyiar Israel Kan. Laporan, diterbitkan pada hari Minggu, menunjukkan bahwa Trump belum membuat keputusan tentang masalah ini enggan untuk melakukannya. Presiden AS Donald Trump mengklaim bahwa dia memprediksi penurunan pasar saham serta serangan keras dari Iran setelah kemenangan Demokrat dalam pemilihan tengah semester. Trump menjelaskan pemilu sebagai "sangat aneh". Dia juga mempertanyakan penurunan harga minyak, mengatakan: "Bukankah ini menarik bahwa harga minyak telah jatuh drastis setelah pemilihan tengah semester? Aku bilang itu akan terjadi. Semuanya adalah Raksasa Hoax!" Sebuah serangan Saudi terhadap kota kunci Yaman di Hodeida menewaskan setidaknya empat orang dan melukai 18 orang lainnya, menurut media yang berhubungan dengan perumahan. Pemogokan dilaporkan menargetkan sebuah bangunan milik Perusahaan Telekomunikasi Publik Yaman. Menteri Pertahanan Korea Selatan Kang Shin- chul mengatakan bahwa gerakan untuk memperpanjang penyebaran unit anti-pembajakan Cheonghae di Teluk Aden tidak termasuk keterlibatan dalam perang AS-Israel terhadap Iran. Sebaliknya, ia mengutip kenaikan pembajakan bersama upaya untuk melindungi kapal Korea Selatan dan warga menggunakan rute maritim.
articles.originalTitle: Morning update
articles.originalDescription: Morning update Good morning Middle East Eye readers, Here are the latest developments: Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei said that Tehran can "act very quickly" to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, granted that the US complies with the country's demands. "Iran remains steadfast in honouring its commitments and will fulfil them as soon as possible, provided the other side complies with the relevant conditions," Baqaei said. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is urging Trump to carry out strikes on Iran "as soon as possible", according to Israel’s public broadcaster Kan. The report, published on Sunday, indicated that Trump has yet to make a decision on the matter is reluctant to do so. US president Donald Trump claimed that he predicted a stock market decline as well as harsher attacks from Iran after the Democratic victory in the recent midterm elections. Trump went onto describe the elections as "very strange". He also questioned the drop in oil prices, saying: "Isn’t it interesting that Oil prices have dropped precipitously after the Midterm Elections? I said that was going to happen. The whole thing is a Giant Hoax!" A Saudi attack on Yemen's key port city of Hodeida killed at least four people and injured 18 others, according to Houthi-affiliated media. The strike reportedly targeted a building belonging to Yemen's Public Telecommunications Corporation. South Korean Defence Minister Kang Shin-chul said that a motion to extend the deployment of the Cheonghae anti-piracy unit in the Gulf of Aden did not amount to involvement in the US-Israeli war on Iran. Instead, he cited a rise in piracy alongside efforts to protect South Korean ships and citizens using the maritime route.

articles.title: biaya konstruksi Arab Saudi naik 2,3% pada bulan Oktober, dipimpin oleh sektor non- perumahan
articles.description: RIYADH - Indeks Biaya Konstruksi Arab Saudi (CCI) meningkat 2,3 persen pada Oktober 2026 dibandingkan dengan bulan yang sama pada tahun 2025, didorong oleh biaya yang lebih tinggi baik dalam konstruksi perumahan maupun non-perumahan, menurut Otoritas Umum untuk Statistik (GASTAT). Laporan otoritas Oktober 2026 menunjukkan bahwa biaya konstruksi non- perumahan naik 2,7 persen tahun-tahun, sementara biaya konstruksi perumahan meningkat sebesar 2,2 persen. Di sektor non- perumahan, peralatan dan biaya rental mesin dicatat peningkatan terbesar sebesar 5,8 persen, didorong oleh kenaikan 7.2 persen biaya sewa peralatan dan mesin dengan operator. Biaya kerja di sektor meningkat 2,1 persen, sementara bahan dasar meningkat 2.0 persen, didukung oleh peningkatan 4.4 persen dari harga bahan bangunan lain. Biaya energi juga meningkat sebesar 3,0 persen. Sementara itu, peningkatan biaya konstruksi perumahan sebagian dikaitkan dengan peningkatan 4.0 persen pada peralatan dan biaya sewa mesin, termasuk kenaikan 5,4 persen biaya sewa untuk peralatan dengan operator. Biaya bahan dasar di sektor perumahan meningkat menjadi 1,8 persen, didukung oleh kenaikan 3,4 persen pada harga kayu dan kerja sama, sementara biaya kerja naik 1,6 persen dan biaya energi meningkat sebesar 3,0 persen. Secara bulanan, Indeks Biaya Konstruksi keseluruhan naik 0,1 persen dibandingkan dengan September 2026, didorong oleh peningkatan 0,1 persen dalam biaya konstruksi non- perumahan, sementara biaya konstruksi tetap tidak berubah. GASTAT mencatat bahwa Indeks Biaya Konstruksi melacak perubahan harga 51 input konstruksi, dengan data dikumpulkan bulanan di 13 wilayah Kingdom dari kantor kontraktor, kantor rekayasa dan pemasok bahan bangunan.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia’s construction costs rise 2.3% in October, led by non-residential sector
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia's Construction Cost Index (CCI) increased by 2.3 percent in October 2026 compared with the same month in 2025, driven by higher costs in both residential and non-residential construction, according to the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT). The authority's October 2026 report showed that non-residential construction costs rose 2.7 percent year-on-year, while residential construction costs increased by 2.2 percent. In the non-residential sector, equipment and machinery rental costs recorded the largest increase at 5.8 percent, driven by a 7.2 percent rise in the cost of renting equipment and machinery with an operator. Labor costs in the sector increased by 2.1 percent, while basic materials rose 2.0 percent, supported by a 4.4 percent increase in the prices of other building materials. Energy costs also increased by 3.0 percent. Meanwhile, the increase in residential construction costs was partly attributed to a 4.0 percent rise in equipment and machinery rental costs, including a 5.4 percent increase in rental costs for equipment with an operator. Basic materials costs in the residential sector increased by 1.8 percent, supported by a 3.4 percent rise in timber and joinery prices, while labor costs rose 1.6 percent and energy costs increased by 3.0 percent. On a monthly basis, the overall Construction Cost Index rose 0.1 percent compared with September 2026, driven by a 0.1 percent increase in non-residential construction costs, while residential construction costs remained unchanged. GASTAT noted that the Construction Cost Index tracks changes in the prices of 51 construction inputs, with data collected monthly across the Kingdom's 13 regions from contractors' offices, engineering offices and construction material suppliers.

articles.title: Pendapat: Anti- Muslim rasisme adalah sistem global yang digunakan untuk menormalkan pembunuhan massal
articles.description: Pendapat: Anti- Muslim rasisme adalah sistem global yang digunakan untuk menormalkan massa membunuh Dr Amina Shareef, seorang peneliti anti- Muslim rasisme, mengatakan bahwa kehancuran berlangsung di Gaza, Iran dan Lebanon adalah bagian dari sejarah yang lebih lama dari anti- rasisme Muslim yang telah membuat massa Muslim penderitaan dan kematian secara politik diperbolehkan. Dia mengatakan bahwa Islamophobia tidak hanya masalah prasangka atau diskriminasi, tetapi sistem global kekuasaan rasial yang membangun Muslim dan mereka diidentifikasi sebagai Muslim sebagai ancaman keamanan, memungkinkan kekerasan terhadap mereka untuk dibenarkan atas nama keamanan. Pusat sistem ini adalah figur teroris Muslim, yang menggambarkan agen politik Muslim sebagai ancaman. Shareef mengatakan bahwa logika ini meluas melampaui pengawasan, penahanan dan perbatasan militer untuk perang, ditinggalkan politik dan kehancuran kondisi yang diperlukan untuk hidup. Dia mengidentifikasi Palestina sebagai situs kunci di mana praktek keamanan kontemporer dan teknologi kontrol telah disempurnakan dan diproduksi kembali di tempat lain, sebuah proses yang dia jelaskan melalui konsep "bumerang Palestina". Meskipun konflik di Iran, Lebanon, Kashmir, Suriah, Yaman, Irak dan Afganistan memiliki sejarah yang berbeda, dia berpendapat bahwa mereka mengungkapkan pola yang berulang di mana populasi Muslim digambarkan sebagai ancaman dan penderitaan mereka menjadi lebih mudah untuk membenarkan. Shareef menyimpulkan bahwa menghadapi anti- Muslim rasisme akhirnya perjuangan untuk melindungi kehidupan dan martabat manusia. Dia menyerukan perlawanan berkelanjutan terhadap sistem yang mengekspos seluruh populasi untuk kematian prematur, menyatakan bahwa tanggung jawab untuk mencari keadilan tetap bahkan ketika hasilnya tidak pasti.
articles.originalTitle: Opinion: Anti-Muslim racism is a global system used to normalise mass killing
articles.originalDescription: Opinion: Anti-Muslim racism is a global system used to normalise mass killing Dr Amina Shareef, a researcher of anti-Muslim racism, says that the destruction unfolding in Gaza, Iran and Lebanon is part of a longer history of anti-Muslim racism that has made mass Muslim suffering and death politically permissible. She says that Islamophobia is not simply a matter of prejudice or discrimination, but a global system of racial power that constructs Muslims and those identified as Muslim as security threats, allowing violence against them to be justified in the name of security. Central to this system is the figure of the Muslim terrorist, which portrays Muslim political agency as inherently threatening. Shareef says that this logic extends beyond surveillance, detention and militarised borders to warfare, political abandonment and the destruction of the conditions necessary for life. She identifies Palestine as a key site where contemporary security practices and technologies of control have been refined and reproduced elsewhere, a process she describes through the concept of the “Palestine boomerang”. Although conflicts in Iran, Lebanon, Kashmir, Syria, Yemen, Iraq and Afghanistan have distinct histories, she argues that they reveal a recurring pattern in which Muslim populations are portrayed as threats and their suffering becomes easier to justify. Shareef concludes that confronting anti-Muslim racism is ultimately a struggle to protect life and human dignity. She calls for sustained resistance to systems that expose entire populations to premature death, arguing that the responsibility to seek justice remains even when the outcome is uncertain.

articles.title: Eisenkot mengutuk 'terorisme Yahudi' dekat Ramallah sebagai anggota Kongres AS meminta pertanggungjawaban
articles.description: Eisenkot mengutuk 'terorisme Yahudi' dekat Ramallah sebagai anggota kongres AS menyerukan akuntabilitas politisi Israel Gadi Eisenkot telah mengutuk serangkaian serangan pembakaran oleh pemukim di Tepi Barat yang diduduki sebagai "terorisme Yahudi", menuduh menteri-menteri yang tepat Bezalel Smotrich dan Itamar Ben Gvir dari fuelling kekerasan terhadap Palestina. Dalam beberapa malam ke hari Minggu, pemukim Israel menyerang tiga desa Palestina di dekat Ramallah, membakar kendaraan dan mengecat slogan rasis di bangunan perumahan. Eisenkot, pemimpin partai Yashar, menggambarkan serangan sebagai "terorisme Yahudi dalam setiap arti kata" dan menyerukan pada pemerintah dan keamanan pembentukan untuk mengambil tindakan yang lebih keras terhadap pemukim kekerasan. "Tindakan sabotase dilakukan oleh kelompok ekstremis membakar kendaraan dan rumah-rumah merusak stabilitas regional, membahayakan nyawa dan serius membahayakan keamanan nasional Israel dan hubungan luar negeri", menulis tentang X. Pemimpin oposisi Yair Lapid juga mengutuk serangan, menyebut mereka "terorisme Yahudi" disebabkan oleh kelalaian pemerintah. "Terorisme Yahudi adalah hasil dari kelalaian kriminal pada bagian dari pemerintah Israel", kata Lapid. "Dengan tetap diam, menteri pemerintah sengaja mendorong pogroms ini". "Ketika kita membentuk pemerintahan, kita akan mengatasi terorisme ini dan mengembalikan pemerintahan, hukum dan ketertiban", tambahnya. Di Amerika Serikat, Anggota Kongres Demokratik Josh Gottheimer mengutuk serangan dan menyerukan pertanggungjawaban. "Insiden ini menjamin penyelidikan penuh dan menyeluruh", Gottheimer menulis pada X, menambahkan bahwa keadilan main hakim sendiri tidak "di masyarakat. Polisi Israel mengatakan mereka telah membuka penyelidikan ke pembakaran, vandalisme dan kerusakan properti.
articles.originalTitle: Eisenkot condemns 'Jewish terrorism' near Ramallah as US congressman calls for accountability
articles.originalDescription: Eisenkot condemns 'Jewish terrorism' near Ramallah as US congressman calls for accountability Israeli politician Gadi Eisenkot has condemned a series of arson attacks by settlers in the occupied West Bank as "Jewish terrorism", accusing far-right ministers Bezalel Smotrich and Itamar Ben Gvir of fuelling violence against Palestinians. Overnight into Sunday, Israeli settlers attacked three Palestinian villages near Ramallah, setting fire to vehicles and spray-painting racist slogans on residential buildings. Eisenkot, leader of the Yashar party, described the attacks as "Jewish terrorism in every sense of the word" and called on the government and security establishment to take tougher action against violent settlers. "The acts of sabotage carried out by extremist groups setting fire to vehicles and homes undermine regional stability, endanger lives and seriously harm Israel's national security and foreign relations," he wrote on X. Opposition leader Yair Lapid also condemned the attacks, calling them "Jewish terrorism" caused by government negligence. "Jewish terrorism is the product of criminal negligence on the part of the Israeli government," Lapid said. "By remaining silent, government ministers are deliberately encouraging these pogroms." "When we form a government, we will tackle this terrorism and restore governance, law and order," he added. In the United States, Democratic Congressman Josh Gottheimer condemned the attacks and called for accountability. "These incidents warrant a full and thorough investigation," Gottheimer wrote on X, adding that vigilante justice had "no place" in society. Israeli police said they had opened investigations into arson, vandalism and property damage.

articles.originalTitle: Workers shot, villagers trapped: Israeli forces and settlers attack Palestinian towns across West Bank
articles.originalDescription: Workers shot, villagers trapped: Israeli forces and settlers attack Palestinian towns across West Bank Israeli forces and settlers carried out raids and attacks across the occupied West Bank on Sunday, injuring and detaining Palestinians, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported. The attacks come amid a sharp escalation in settler violence in the territory. Overnight into Sunday, Israeli settlers attacked three Palestinian villages, setting fire to 12 vehicles and spray-painting racist slogans on residential buildings. The attacks targeted Kafr Malik, Deir Abu Mash'al and Deir al-Sudan, in the Ramallah and al-Bireh governorate. Near Hizma, north-east of Jerusalem, Israeli forces fired live ammunition at Palestinian workers trying to cross the separation wall into the city, wounding several of them, according to the Jerusalem Governorate. Around 18 workers were detained, and video footage showed one of them being severely beaten. The Palestine Red Crescent said it treated two people who were injured after being beaten by Israeli forces and falling from the wall. Israeli forces later closed the entrances to Hizma and forced shops to shut. In al-Mughayyir, north-east of Ramallah, several Palestinians were injured by flying glass when settlers attacked vehicles on Sunday evening, the head of the village council, Amin Abu Alia, told Wafa. Abu Alia said settlers, protected by Israeli forces, gathered at the village entrances and prevented residents from entering or leaving. He added that Israeli forces detained several Palestinians, and that there was no information so far on their fate or whereabouts. Many Palestinian residents were also left stranded in the neighbouring village of Abu Falah, unable to return home. South of Jenin, Israeli forces raided the towns of Anza, Jaba', Arraba and Ya'bad. articles.title: Arab Saudi sangat mengutuk serangan drone menargetkan Khartoum
articles.description: RIYADH - Kementerian Luar Negeri menyatakan hukuman yang sangat berat bagi Arab Saudi atas serangan pesawat tak berawak yang menargetkan ibukota Sudan, Khartoum, termasuk serangan terhadap gedung PBB, yang mengakibatkan korban warga sipil dan kerusakan infrastruktur dan fasilitas sipil. Dalam sebuah pernyataan, kementrian mengatakan: "Kerajaan secara kategori menolak serangan brutal ini dan menekankan pentingnya menghormati hukum kemanusiaan internasional, memenuhi kewajiban untuk melindungi warga sipil, fasilitas sipil, dan tempat organisasi internasional, memastikan keselamatan personil mereka, dan menyelamatkan rakyat Sudan lebih lanjut". Arab Saudi menegaskan kembali posisinya yang teguh menyerukan pelestarian keamanan Sudan, stabilitas, kesatuan, kedaulatan, dan lembaga yang sah. Menteri juga menyampaikan belasungkawa sebesar-besarnya kepada keluarga korban dan berharap yang terluka cepat sembuh.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia strongly condemns drone attacks targeting Khartoum
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed Saudi Arabia’s strong condemnation of the drone attacks targeting the Sudanese capital, Khartoum, including the attack on a United Nations building, which resulted in civilian casualties and damage to civilian infrastructure and facilities. In a statement, the ministry said: “The Kingdom categorically rejects these brutal attacks and stresses the importance of respecting international humanitarian law, fulfilling the obligation to protect civilians, civilian facilities, and the premises of international organizations, ensuring the safety of their personnel, and sparing the Sudanese people further suffering.” Saudi Arabia reiterated its steadfast position calling for the preservation of Sudan’s security, stability, unity, sovereignty, and legitimate institutions. The ministry also extended the Kingdom’s sincere condolences to the families of the victims and wished the injured a speedy recovery.

articles.title: Mendagri meletakkan fondasi batu untuk Unified Security Operation Center in Salam
articles.description: HAIL - Menteri Dalam Negeri Pangeran Abdullah bin Saud bin Naif meletakkan fondasi batu untuk Unified Security Operation Center (911) di Wilayah Hail pada hari Minggu. Upacara diadakan di hadapan Emir dari Salam Pangeran Abdullah bin Saad. Menteri itu diberitahu tentang proyek, yang merupakan salah satu Kementerian Dalam Negeri apos; s inisiatif strategis. Sedang diimplementasikan dalam kerjasama dengan Kualitas Hidup Program, salah satu dari Saudi Vision 2030 program, proyek bertujuan untuk menyatukan nomor darurat dan pusat operasi di wilayah Kerajaan. Ini akan memperkuat integrasi antara keamanan dan lembaga pelayanan dan meningkatkan efisiensi respon operasional. Pangeran Abdulaziz juga melihat presentasi memperkenalkan pusat, menguraikan fungsi ruang operasinya dan mekanisme mengatur pekerjaan mereka dalam sistem operasional terpadu. Pusat terdiri dari empat ruang operasi di tingkat regional dan akan melayani kota Hail dan delapan pemerintahan, sehingga meningkatkan efisiensi respon darurat. Deputi Emir dari Salam Pangeran Faisal bin Fahd dan sejumlah pejabat senior menghadiri pendiri-batu peletakan upacara. * * Media [2798361] * * Selama kunjungan, menteri interior bertemu dengan anggota komite keamanan di wilayah Hail, di hadapan Emir of Hail. Menteri itu diberitahu tentang pekerjaan dan tanggung jawab komite keamanan, terutama perannya dalam mengkoordinasikan upaya keamanan dan lembaga-lembaga militer dan memonitor semua hal yang berkaitan dengan keamanan wilayah. Pangeran Abdulaziz memuji upaya dedikasi keamanan dan personil militer dalam melaksanakan tugas mereka, memuji pengabdian mereka dan kesetiaan dalam keamanan dan melayani agama mereka, Raja mereka dan negara mereka. Dia mengarahkan anggota komite untuk menyampaikan salam dan apresiasi kepada personil di masing-masing sektor.
articles.originalTitle: Interior minister lays foundation stone for Unified Security Operations Center in Hail
articles.originalDescription: HAIL — Minister of Interior Prince Abdulaziz bin Saud bin Naif laid the foundation stone for the Unified Security Operations Center (911) in the Hail region on Sunday. The ceremony was held in the presence of Emir of Hail Prince Abdulaziz bin Saad. The minister was briefed on the project, which is one of the Ministry of Interior’s strategic initiatives. Being implemented in cooperation with the Quality of Life Program, one of the Saudi Vision 2030 programs, the project aims to unify emergency numbers and operations centers across the Kingdom’s regions. This will strengthen integration among security and service agencies and enhance operational response efficiency. Prince Abdulaziz also viewed a presentation introducing the center, outlining the functions of its operations rooms and the mechanisms governing their work within an integrated operational system. The center comprises four operations rooms at the regional level and will serve the city of Hail and eight governorates, thereby enhancing emergency response efficiency. Deputy Emir of Hail Prince Faisal bin Fahd and a number of senior officials attended the foundation-stone laying ceremony. **media[2798361]** During the visit, the minister of interior met with members of the security committee in the Hail region, in the presence of the Emir of Hail. The minister was briefed on the security committee’s work and responsibilities, particularly its role in coordinating the efforts of security and military agencies and monitoring all matters relating to the region’s security. Prince Abdulaziz commended the dedicated efforts of security and military personnel in carrying out their duties, praising their devotion and loyalty in safeguarding security and serving their religion, their King and their country. He directed the committee members to convey his greetings and appreciation to personnel across their respective sectors.

articles.description: Dua orang Palestina dibunuh oleh api Israel di utara dan pusat Gaza pasukan Israel menewaskan dua orang Palestina dalam serangan terpisah di Jalur Gaza pada hari Minggu, agen berita Palestina Wafa melaporkan. Pada malam hari, sebuah pesawat tak berawak Israel menyerang dan membunuh satu lagi orang Palestina di timur Deir, Baku, di pusat Gaza. articles.originalTitle: Two Palestinians killed by Israeli fire in northern and central Gaza
articles.originalDescription: Two Palestinians killed by Israeli fire in northern and central Gaza Israeli forces killed two Palestinians in separate attacks in the Gaza Strip on Sunday, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported. One was shot dead by Israeli gunfire in Jabalia, north of Gaza, on Sunday evening. Earlier in the evening, an Israeli quadcopter drone struck and killed another Palestinian in eastern Deir al-Balah, in central Gaza. Israel has killed more than 1,600 Palestinians in Gaza since the ceasefire agreement of October 2025. At least 74,742 Palestinians have been killed and 176,227 wounded since the war began in October 2023.

articles.title: Bahrain mengatakan serangan Iran luka dua, satu kritis
articles.description: Bahrain mengatakan luka mogok Iran dua, satu yang kritis Bahrain mengatakan pada hari Minggu bahwa dua orang terluka dalam serangan Iran pada hari sebelumnya pada "situs industri sipil" di kerajaan Teluk, yang telah menghadapi beberapa serangan minggu ini. Korps Garda Revolusi Iran (IRGC) berkali-kali mengatakan mereka menargetkan fasilitas AS di Bahrain, di mana serangan Iran dilanjutkan pada bulan November. "Di tengah serangan kriminal Iran yang menderita kemarin (Sabtu) oleh Kerajaan Bahrain... seorang warga negara Bahraini dengan cacat terluka", kata Kementerian Dalam Negeri Bahrain X "Kondisinya stabil. Seorang warga Pakistan juga terluka dan dalam kondisi kritis". Penduduk melihat asap naik di atas Sitra Island, timur dari Manama, yang menjadi tuan rumah beberapa fasilitas industri, termasuk kilang minyak yang dioperasikan oleh perusahaan minyak milik Bapco, AFP melaporkan. Dalam pernyataan yang dilakukan oleh media negara Iran pada Sabtu malam, IRGC mengatakan mereka telah menyerang US Patriot sistem pertahanan udara dengan rudal dan drone di Al- Riffa dan Awali basa di Bahrain, dalam menanggapi "melanjutkan pelanggaran wilayah udara" Republik Islam. Departemen luar negeri Bahrain menolak akun IRGC, yang mengatakan situs itu murni milik warga sipil dan industri, menyebut serangan itu sebagai bahaya langsung bagi warga sipil dan pelanggaran kedaulatan kerajaan. Tetangga Bahrain di Arab Saudi pada hari Minggu juga mengutuk Teheran atas serangan terhadap negara-negara Teluk. Kementerian Luar Negeri Saudi menyatakan bahwa X adalah kutukan terkuat dan pengaduan terhadap serangan kriminal Iran terhadap fasilitas industri sipil di Kerajaan Bahrain bersaudara. Sebagai hasil dari serangan kejam dari Iran di Bahrain kemarin, seorang warga Bahraini dengan cacat yang berkelanjutan dan dalam kondisi stabil, sementara warga Pakistan juga terluka dan dalam kondisi kritis. Keduanya menerima perawatan di rumah sakit. # Bahrain # MOI - 22 November 2026
articles.originalTitle: Bahrain says Iranian strike wounds two, one critically
articles.originalDescription: Bahrain says Iranian strike wounds two, one critically Bahrain said on Sunday that two people were wounded in an Iranian strike the previous day on “a civilian industrial site” in the Gulf kingdom, which has faced several attacks this week. Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has repeatedly said they targeted US facilities in Bahrain, where Iranian strikes resumed earlier in November. "In the wake of the criminal Iranian attacks suffered yesterday (Saturday) by the Kingdom of Bahrain… a Bahraini national with a disability was wounded," Bahrain's interior ministry said on X. "His condition is stable. A Pakistani resident was also wounded and is in critical condition." Residents had seen smoke rising above Sitra Island, east of Manama, which hosts several industrial facilities, including a refinery operated by the state-owned oil company Bapco, AFP reported. In a statement carried by Iranian state media on Saturday evening, the IRGC said they had attacked US Patriot air defence systems with missiles and drones at the Al-Riffa and Awali bases in Bahrain, in response to the “continued violations of the airspace” of the Islamic Republic. Bahrain's foreign ministry dismissed the IRGC's account, saying the site hit was purely civilian and industrial, calling the attack a direct danger to civilians and a violation of the kingdom's sovereignty. Bahrain's neighbour Saudi Arabia on Sunday also condemned Tehran for its attacks on Gulf countries. The Saudi foreign ministry expressed on X "the strongest condemnation and denunciation... of the criminal Iranian attacks against a civilian industrial facility in the brotherly Kingdom of Bahrain". As a result of the heinous Iranian attacks on Bahrain yesterday, a Bahraini citizen with disabilities sustained injuries and is in stable condition, while a Pakistani resident was also injured and is in critical condition. Both are receiving treatment in the hospital. #Bahrain #MOI — وزارة الداخلية - Ministry of Interior (@moi_bahrain) N

articles.title: Dari pembakaran sampai kejang tanah: Settlers mengencangkan pegangan pada desa-desa Palestina dekat Ramallah
articles.description: Dari pembakaran tanah ke kejang: Settlers mengencangkan pegangan pada desa-desa Palestina dekat Ramallah Dipersembahkan oleh Fayha Shalash pada matahari, 11 / 22 / 2026 - 13: 25 Serangan tersebut terjadi di tengah-tengah peningkatan kekuatan Israel dan Palestina dalam dugaan serangan pembakaran di Idna, bagian barat Hebron, menduduki Bank Barat, 5 Juni 2026 (Hazem Bader / AFP) dalam serangkaian serangan terkoordinasi di beberapa desa dekat Ramallah di pusat Bank Barat, pemukim Israel yang menyerang antara kendaraan Palestina dan Sabtu pagi. Para pemukim juga menyemprotkan slogan rasis di dinding rumah di tiga desa, menyerukan pembunuhan orang Arab dan balas dendam terhadap mereka. Rafat Abu Musa, kepala dewan desa Deir Al- Sudan, sebelah utara Ramallah, mengatakan kepada penduduk Mata Timur Tengah bahwa pemukim menyusup bagian selatan desa pada 11: 30 pada hari Sabtu dan membakar dua kendaraan. Para pemukim menyemprot slogan dalam bahasa Ibrani di dinding rumah-rumah terdekat, katanya, menambahkan bahwa daerah yang sama telah ditargetkan oleh serangan yang sama dua bulan yang lalu, di mana kendaraan itu dibakar. Para pemukim, katanya, datang dari pos yang baru dibangun pada puncak Jabal al- Ras, terletak di desa tetangga Umm Safa. "Pemadam kebakaran tertunda dalam mencapai tempat kejadian karena mereka membutuhkan koordinasi dengan tentara Israel; pada saat mereka tiba, kendaraan sudah berkurang menjadi abu," katanya. Menurut Abu Musa, sekitar lima bulan yang lalu, pemukim merebut "seluruh gunung" di bagian selatan desa, di mana mereka mendirikan pos dan membangun jalan. Pos terdepan telah melepaskan warga akses ke lebih dari setengah pohon zaitun desa, sebagai pendatang menyerang penduduk dan mencegah mereka dari mendekati tanah mereka sendiri, katanya. "Penyerangan sengit ini sedang diarahkan oleh menteri-menteri Israel yang ekstremis, ini adalah sistematis dan serangan berulang," kata Abu Musa. articles.originalDescription: From arson to land seizures: Settlers tighten grip on Palestinian villages near Ramallah Submitted by Fayha Shalash on Sun, 11/22/2026 - 13:25 The attacks come amid a sharp rise in settler violence during the olive harvest, with the UN documenting a record 467 incidents in October An Israeli settler stands between Israeli forces and Palestinians protesting an alleged arson attack in Idna, west of Hebron, occupied West Bank, 5 June 2026 (Hazem Bader/AFP) Off In a series of coordinated attacks across several villages near the city of Ramallah in the central occupied West Bank, Israeli settlers torched Palestinian vehicles between Saturday evening and Sunday morning. The settlers also spray-painted racist slogans on the walls of homes in the three villages, calling for the killing of Arabs and for revenge against them. Rafat Abu Musa, head of the village council of Deir al-Sudan, north of Ramallah, told Middle East Eye that settlers infiltrated the southern part of the village at 11.30pm on Saturday and burned down two vehicles. The settlers spray-painted slogans in Hebrew on the walls of nearby houses, he said, adding that the same area had been targeted by a similar attack two months ago, during which a vehicle was set on fire. The settlers, he said, came from a newly built outpost on the summit of Jabal al-Ras, located in the neighbouring village of Umm Safa. "The fire department was delayed in reaching the scene because they require coordination with the Israeli army; by the time they arrived, the vehicles had already been reduced to ashes," he said. According to Abu Musa, some five months ago, the settlers seized "an entire mountain" in the southern part of the village, where they established an outpost and constructed roads. The outpost has deprived residents of access to more than half of the village’s olive trees, as settlers assault the residents and prevent them from approaching their own land, he said. articles.title: Houthis mengatakan mereka menyerang kilang minyak Arab Saudi
articles.description: Houthis mengatakan mereka menyerang kilang minyak Saudi Arabia di dekat pantai Laut Merah di Jeddah. Pihak berwenang Saudi tidak segera berkomentar. Houthis telah mengklaim serangkaian serangan terhadap infrastruktur energi Saudi dalam beberapa bulan terakhir. Pantai Laut Merah kerajaan telah menjadi semakin penting bagi ekspor minyak, dengan Riyadh menggunakan pipa Timur-Barat untuk bergerak mentah dari Teluk ke pelabuhan barat, daripada melalui Selat Hormuz.
articles.originalTitle: Houthis say they attacked Saudi Arabia's Rabigh oil refinery
articles.originalDescription: Houthis say they attacked Saudi Arabia's Rabigh oil refinery Yemen's Houthis said on Sunday they had attacked Saudi Arabia 's Rabigh oil refinery on the kingdom's Red Sea coast north of Jeddah. Saudi authorities did not immediately comment. The Houthis have claimed a string of attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure in recent months. The kingdom's Red Sea coast has become increasingly important to its oil exports, with Riyadh using its East-West pipeline to move crude from the Gulf to western ports, rather than through the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Transformasi digital Arab Saudi meningkat 90%, memberikan SR26 miliar dalam tabungan tahunan
articles.description: RIYADH - Pemerintah Digital Saudi Gubernur Eng, Ahmed Alsuwaiyan menyoroti prestasi utama transformasi digital Kingdom, mencatat bahwa tingkat transformasi digital diharapkan melebihi 90 persen pada akhir 2026. Prestasi ini telah menghasilkan tabungan tahunan lebih dari SR26 miliar dan menghilangkan lebih dari 1,3 juta pengunjung setiap hari melalui pengiriman layanan digital, katanya. Berbicara di konferensi pers pemerintah yang diselenggarakan oleh Kementerian Media, Alsuwayyan menjelaskan bahwa jasa Departemen Dalam Negeri melalui platform "Absher" telah membantu mempercepat transaksi, prosedur perampingan, dan meningkatkan pengalaman pengguna. Banyak layanan yang sebelumnya membutuhkan empat jam untuk menyelesaikan sekarang dapat disampaikan hanya dalam 30 detik. Dia mencatat bahwa 95 persen sesi pengadilan sekarang dilakukan dari jarak jauh melalui pengadilan virtual, secara signifikan mengurangi durasi proses peradilan dari 219 hari hanya 20 hari dan menghilangkan lebih dari 60 juta kunjungan tahunan ke fasilitas peradilan. Dalam sektor haji dan Umrah, jumlah pengguna platform Nusk telah melampaui 60 juta, sementara Al-Rawdah Al- Sharifah di Masjid Nabi akomodasi 55.000 pengunjung setiap hari. Proceksi untuk mengeluarkan haji dan visa Umrah juga telah dipersingkat, dengan proses sekarang mengambil hanya lima menit, dibandingkan dengan lima hari sebelumnya, sedangkan lebih dari 22 juta visa diperkirakan akan dikeluarkan oleh 2025. Di sektor kesehatan, 51 persen dari janji medis kini tersedia dari jarak jauh, sementara waktu pengobatan dipotong kurang dari delapan menit, dibandingkan 72 jam sebelumnya. Peningkatan ini telah menghasilkan tabungan dari biaya pengobatan SR1,5 miliar. Alsuwayyan mengatakan bahwa Arab Saudi juga telah membuat lebih dari 1.800 layanan pemerintah dapat diakses melalui aplikasi Tawakakalna, memproses lebih dari 88 juta transaksi setiap hari. articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia’s digital transformation tops 90%, delivers SR26 billion in annual savings
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Digital Government Authority Governor Eng. Ahmed Alsuwaiyan highlighted the major achievements of the Kingdom’s digital transformation, noting that the digital transformation rate is expected to exceed 90 percent by the end of 2026. These achievements have generated annual savings of more than SR26 billion and eliminated over 1.3 million daily in-person visits through the delivery of digital services, he said. Speaking at the government press conference organized by the Ministry of Media, Alsuwaiyan explained that the Ministry of Interior’s services through the “Absher” platform have helped expedite transactions, streamline procedures, and enhance the user experience. Many services that previously took four hours to complete can now be delivered in just 30 seconds.He noted that 95 percent of court sessions are now conducted remotely through virtual courts, significantly reducing the duration of judicial proceedings from 219 days to just 20 days and eliminating more than 60 million annual visits to judicial facilities. In the Hajj and Umrah sector, the number of users of the Nusk platform has surpassed 60 million, while Al-Rawdah Al-Sharifah at the Prophet’s Mosque accommodates 55,000 visitors daily. Procedures for issuing Hajj and Umrah visas have also been streamlined, with the process now taking just five minutes, compared to five days previously, while more than 22 million visas are expected to be issued by 2025.In the healthcare sector, 51 percent of medical appointments are now provided remotely, while medication dispensing time has been cut to less than eight minutes, compared to 72 hours previously. These improvements have generated savings of SR1.5 billion in medication costs.Alsuwaiyan said that Saudi Arabia has also made more than 1,800 government services accessible through the Tawakkalna application, processing over 88 million transactions daily. articles.originalTitle: Why is Turkey warning of an Israeli military operation in Syria?
articles.originalDescription: Why is Turkey warning of an Israeli military operation in Syria? Submitted by Reem Aouir on Sun, 11/22/2026 - 13:21 FM Hakan Fidan says Israel is flying weapons to an armed Druze group in southern Syria every week to provoke the Syrian army, and that Ankara has warned Washington A man hangs a poster of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu beside a Druze flag in Majdal Shams, Israeli-annexed Golan Heights, 17 October 2026 (Jalaa Marey/AFP) Off Turkey 's foreign minister has warned that Israel could launch a military operation in Syria , accusing it of backing a faction within the country's Druze community in an attempt to provoke the Syrian army and create a pretext for intervention. Hakan Fidan made the remarks in a televised interview with Turkish broadcaster TGRT Haber on Saturday, saying Ankara had raised the possibility with regional allies, as well as US and European officials. "There is a scenario in which the Israeli army uses this as a pretext to launch an operation against Syria," Fidan said. The Turkish foreign minister also alleged that Israel was supporting one of three major factions within Syria's Druze community, supplying it with weapons and ammunition by helicopter on a weekly basis. “In southern Syria, as you know, there are Druze. These Druze are divided into three major tribes within Syria. Two of these are genuinely on the side of the Syrian government and are anti-Israel. But one of them is supported by Israel.” He claimed the faction was seeking to provoke Syrian government forces, potentially giving Israel justification to intervene militarily. Omer Ozkizilcik, a non-resident senior fellow at the Atlantic Council, described Ankara’s warning as a precautionary move. “Turkey's public warning aims at preventing Israel from doing something stupid in southern Syria before Israel actually does it,” he told Middle East Eye. articles.title: KFSH melakukan hampir dua pertiga transplantasi hati di Arab Saudi
articles.description: RIYADH - Raja Spesialis Faisal & Pusat Penelitian (KFSH) melakukan sekitar 63% pencangkokan hati di Saudi Arabia pada tahun 2023 dan 2024, akuntansi untuk hampir dua-pertiga prosedur yang direkam oleh Saudi Center for Organ Translantation (SCOT). Rumah sakit juga melakukan hampir setengah dari semua transplantasi ginjal dilakukan di seluruh Kingdom selama periode yang sama. KFSH telah melakukan lebih dari 1.000 transplantasi organ padat setiap tahunnya selama empat tahun berturut-turut, dengan total 4.330 prosedur antara 2022 dan 2025, termasuk 1.109 di 2025 saja. Prosedur termasuk ginjal, hati, jantung, paru-paru, pankreas dan transplantasi usus. Program transplantasi ginjal rumah sakit melaporkan satu tahun pasien dan mencangkok tingkat kelangsungan hidup berkisar dari 97% sampai 99%. Klinik transplantasi KFSH juga merekam sekitar 86.000 kunjungan pada tahun 2025 sebagai bagian dari sistem perawatan terpadu yang ditujukan untuk menjaga kesehatan pasien dan mempertahankan fungsi jangka panjang organ transplantasi. Rumah sakit terus melanjutkan teknik bedah transplantasi organ, setelah melakukan transplantasi hati robot pertama di dunia pada tahun 2023, diikuti oleh transplantasi jantung robot pertama di dunia pada tahun 2024. Ini milestone medis telah membantu mengurangi trauma bedah terkait dengan prosedur transplantasi kompleks. KFSH peringkat pertama di Timur Tengah dan Afrika dan 12 di seluruh dunia 250 pusat medis akademik terbaik di 2026. Ini juga dinamakan merek kesehatan yang paling berharga di Arab Saudi dan Timur Tengah untuk 2026 oleh Keuangan Brand. Rumah sakit juga telah ditampilkan di Newsweek 's Best Hospital 2026, Rumah Sakit Cerdas Terbaik Dunia 2027 dan Rumah Sakit Terbaik Dunia 2027.
articles.originalTitle: KFSH performs nearly two-thirds of liver transplants in Saudi Arabia
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre (KFSH) performed approximately 63% of all liver transplants in Saudi Arabia in 2023 and 2024 combined, accounting for nearly two-thirds of the 1,018 procedures recorded by the Saudi Center for Organ Transplantation (SCOT).The hospital also performed nearly half of all kidney transplants conducted across the Kingdom during the same period.KFSH has performed more than 1,000 solid organ transplants annually for four consecutive years, with a total of 4,330 procedures between 2022 and 2025, including 1,109 in 2025 alone.The procedures included kidney, liver, heart, lung, pancreas and intestine transplants.The hospital's kidney transplant program reported one-year patient and graft survival rates ranging from 97% to 99%.KFSH's transplant clinics also recorded approximately 86,000 follow-up visits in 2025 as part of an integrated care system aimed at preserving patients' health and maintaining the long-term function of transplanted organs.The hospital continues to advance surgical techniques in organ transplantation, having performed the world's first fully robotic liver transplant in 2023, followed by the world's first fully robotic heart transplant in 2024.These medical milestones have helped reduce surgical trauma associated with complex transplant procedures.KFSH ranked first in the Middle East and Africa and 12th globally among the world's top 250 academic medical centers for 2026.It was also named the most valuable healthcare brand in Saudi Arabia and the Middle East for 2026 by Brand Finance.The hospital has also been featured in Newsweek's World's Best Hospitals 2026, World's Best Smart Hospitals 2027 and World's Best Specialized Hospitals 2027 rankings.

articles.title: Arab Saudi, Qatar bergabung dengan kutukan serangan Iran terhadap Bahrain
articles.description: Arab Saudi, Qatar bergabung dengan kutukan serangan Iran terhadap Bahrain Arab Saudi dan Qatar telah bergabung dengan UEE dalam mengutuk serangan Iran terhadap Bahrain pada hari Minggu. Dalam pernyataan yang diposting di X, menteri luar negeri Qatar menyatakan "penolakan kategoris terhadap serangan terhadap fasilitas ekonomi, obyek sipil dan warga sipil, dan menegaskan bahwa kelanjutan serangan ini mewakili eskalasi berbahaya yang mengancam keamanan dan stabilitas daerah". Arab Saudi, sementara itu, mengatakan "perusahaan-perusahaan solidaritas penuh dengan Bahrain dalam segala hal yang diperlukan untuk melindungi keamanan dan stabilitas," menuduh Teheran merusak keamanan daerah dan stabilitas ". Iran menyerang pangkalan militer AS di Qatar dan Arab Saudi, bersama Bahrain, Kuwait, UEE, Oman, Irak dan Yordania selama bulan-bulan pertama perang, yang dimulai pada akhir Februari. Tapi serangan seperti itu telah memikat sejak April tengah negosiasi gencatan senjata antara Washington dan Teheran. # Pernyataan 124; Kementerian Luar Negeri menyatakan Kerajaan Hukuman dan Pengungkapan Arab Saudi, dalam istilah terkuat, serangan kejam Iran terhadap fasilitas industri sipil di Kerajaan Bahrain. The Kingdom menegaskan solidaritas penuh dengan Bahrain dalam segala hal yang diperlukan untuk melindungi keamanan dan stabilitas. - Kementerian Luar Negeri (@ KSAmofaEN) November 22, 2026
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia, Qatar join condemnation of Iran attack on Bahrain
articles.originalDescription: Saudi Arabia, Qatar join condemnation of Iran attack on Bahrain Saudi Arabia and Qatar have joined the UAE in condemning Iran's attack on Bahrain earlier on Sunday. In a statement posted on X, Qatar's foreign ministry expressed its "categorical rejection of attacks on economic facilities, civilian objects and civilians, and affirms that the continuation of these attacks represents a dangerous escalation that threatens the region’s security and stability”. Saudi Arabia, meanwhile, said it "affirms its full solidarity with Bahrain in all measures it takes to protect its security and stability", accusing Tehran of "undermining regional security and stability”. Iran attacked US military bases in both Qatar and Saudi Arabia, along with Bahrain, Kuwait, the UAE, Oman, Iraq and Jordan throughout the first months of the war, which began in late February. But such attacks have lulled since April amid ceasefire negotiations between Washington and Tehran. #Statement | The Foreign Ministry expresses the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia’s condemnation and denunciation, in the strongest terms, of the heinous Iranian attacks on a civilian industrial facility in the brotherly Kingdom of Bahrain. The Kingdom affirms its full solidarity with Bahrain in all measures it takes to protect its security and stability. — Foreign Ministry 🇸🇦 (@KSAmofaEN) November 22, 2026

articles.description: RIYADH - Tanah, laut, dan bandara Bea Cukai udara di Saudi Arabia mencatat 1,053 kejang barang terlarang minggu lalu. Kejang ini termasuk 31 jenis narkotika, seperti ganja, kokain, heroin, dan pil Captagonal; 263 zat terlarang lainnya; dan 781 kasus yang melibatkan tembakau. Ini adalah bagian dari upaya dari badan amal, pajak dan Bea Cukai (ZATCA) untuk memerangi penyelundupan dan melindungi masyarakat. ZATCA menegaskan kembali komitmennya untuk memperkuat pengawasan bea cukai dari impor dan ekspor Kingdom dalam koordinasi dengan otoritas yang relevan. Pihak berwenang mendesak publik untuk membantu penyelundupan dan melindungi ekonomi nasional dengan melaporkan aktivitas mencurigakan melalui hotline keamanan (1910), email (1910 @ zatca.gov.sa), atau nomor internasional (0096661910). Semua laporan tentang penyelundupan dan pelanggaran UU Bea Cukai Unified diperlakukan secara rahasia. Hadiah keuangan juga ditawarkan untuk informasi terbukti akurat, katanya.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Customs ports record 1,053 contraband seizures last week
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Land, sea, and air Customs ports across Saudi Arabia recorded 1,053 seizures of prohibited goods last week. The seizures included 31 types of narcotics, such as hashish, cocaine, heroin, and Captagon pills; 263 other prohibited substances; and 781 cases involving tobacco. This was part of the efforts of the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) to combat smuggling and protect society. ZATCA reaffirmed its commitment to strengthening customs oversight of the Kingdom’s imports and exports in coordination with relevant authorities. The authority urged the public to help combat smuggling and protect the national economy by reporting suspicious activities through its security hotline (1910), email (1910@zatca.gov.sa), or international number (009661910). All reports concerning smuggling and violations of the Unified Customs Law are treated as strictly confidential. Financial rewards are also offered for information proven accurate, it said.

"Sudah jelas bahwa ada partai di aula ini yang menentang teks ini. Kami mengakui bahwa tidak ada konsensus pada dokumen ini. Oleh karena itu, keputusan ini belum diadopsi", katanya penuh penutupan. "Kami telah melakukan maksimal. Pada akhirnya, kami tidak memaksakan teks ini pada siapa pun, atau kami mengeluarkan ultimatum seperti' mengambilnya atau meninggalkannya 'permintaan." Uni Eropa, Kepulauan Marshall, Panama, Norwegia dan Vanuatu adalah salah satu dari mereka yang secara resmi keberatan untuk mengusulkan Antalya Pact. Perjanjian konsep Cop31' the worst ever ', juru kampanye memperingatkan Lebih "Menteri Iklim Irlandia Darragh O' Brien, berbicara atas nama Uni Eropa, secara resmi menolak Antalya Pakt, mengatakan gagal untuk memenuhi urgensi krisis iklim." Kami tidak akan mendukung keputusan yang tidak menanggapi ilmu pengetahuan, dan bahwa benar-benar risiko memperdalam jurang antara komitmen global dan tindakan yang diperlukan... yang bahkan tidak menyebutkan bahan bakar fosil, "katanya. The European Union, the Marshall Islands, Panama, Norway and Vanuatu were among those that formally objected to the proposed Antalya Pact. articles.title: Arab Saudi, Bulgaria untuk memperkuat AI, kemitraan teknologi
articles.description: RIYADH - Menteri Komunikasi dan Teknologi Informasi Abdullah Alswaha bertemu dengan Menteri Inovasi Bulgaria dan Transformasi Digital Ivan Vasilev di Riyadh pada hari Minggu. Selama pertemuan, mereka membahas prospek untuk kemitraan antara dua negara dalam kecerdasan buatan, inovasi teknologi, dan perkembangan kapasitas, dalam mendukung pertumbuhan ekonomi digital. Para menteri meninjau peluang untuk memperkuat kerjasama dalam mengembangkan solusi inovatif, bertukar keahlian dalam membangun kemampuan digital, mendukung kewirausahaan teknologi, dan memperluas kemitraan antara perusahaan di dua negara.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia, Bulgaria to strengthen AI, technology partnership
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Minister of Communications and Information Technology Abdullah Alswaha met with Bulgarian Minister of Innovation and Digital Transformation Ivan Vasilev in Riyadh on Sunday. During the meeting, they discussed prospects for partnership between the two countries in artificial intelligence, technology innovation, and capacity development, in support of digital economy growth. The ministers reviewed opportunities to strengthen cooperation in developing innovative solutions, exchanging expertise in building digital capabilities, supporting technology entrepreneurship, and expanding partnerships between companies in the two countries.

articles.title: Tanggal produksi Arab Saudi naik 7.6% menjadi lebih dari 2 juta ton pada tahun 2025
articles.description: RIYADH - Arab Saudi tanggal produksi naik 7,6 persen tahun-tahun ke lebih dari 2 juta ton pada tahun 2025, sedangkan jumlah pohon palem mencapai 37.9 juta, termasuk 34.7 juta pohon bantalan buah. Otoritas Umum untuk Statistik (GASTAT) mengungkapkan dalam nya Statistik Pertanian 2025 laporan bahwa beragam Khalas dipimpin produksi tanggal di 654.800 ton, dengan 11.1 juta pohon palem, termasuk 10,2 juta buah bantalan pohon. Sementara itu, total produksi gandum mencapai sekitar 1,5 juta ton, dengan akuntansi gandum sebesar 65,8 persen, atau 965,700 ton, turun 18,6 persen dibandingkan dengan 2024. Open- bidang produksi sayuran naik 5,5 persen ke sekitar 2,9 juta ton, dipimpin oleh kentang di 653.000 ton dan watermelon di 633.000 ton. Produksi sayuran Greenhouse juga meningkat 3,8 persen menjadi sekitar 828.000 ton, dengan tomat akuntansi sebesar 343.400 ton dan mentimun 240,900 ton. Laporan ini juga menunjukkan bahwa jumlah pohon-pohon permanen, tidak termasuk pohon-pohon kurma, mencapai 44,8 juta, dengan produksi melebihi 1 juta ton, naik 4,7 persen tahun-tahun. Zaitun pohon berisi saham terbesar, dengan 22.1 juta pohon dan produksi jumlah 361.000 ton. Sementara itu, pertanian organik dan daerah di bawah konversi menghasilkan 87.000 ton, menandai penurunan 115 persen dibandingkan dengan 2024. ekspor pertanian naik 21.5 persen menjadi 614.000 ton, sedangkan impor pertanian meningkat 7,7 persen menjadi 20,2 juta ton. Laporan tersebut menunjukkan pada 2025 Survey pertanian dan catatan administratif dari Kementerian Lingkungan, Air dan Pertanian, Dana Pengembangan Pertanian dan Bank Pusat Saudi.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia's date production rises 7.6% to over 2 million tons in 2025
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia's date production rose 7.6 percent year-on-year to over 2 million tons in 2025, while the number of palm trees reached 37.9 million, including 34.7 million fruit-bearing trees. The General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) revealed in its Agricultural Statistics 2025 report that the Khalas variety led date production at 654,800 tons, with 11.1 million palm trees, including 10.2 million fruit-bearing trees. Meanwhile, total grain production reached approximately 1.5 million tons, with wheat accounting for 65.8 percent, or 965,700 tons, down 18.6 percent compared with 2024. Open-field vegetable production rose 5.5 percent to approximately 2.9 million tons, led by potatoes at 653,000 tons and watermelons at 633,000 tons. Greenhouse vegetable production also increased by 3.8 percent to approximately 828,000 tons, with tomatoes accounting for 343,400 tons and cucumbers 240,900 tons. The report also showed that the number of permanent trees, excluding date palms, reached 44.8 million, with production exceeding 1 million tons, up 4.7 percent year-on-year. Olive trees accounted for the largest share, with 22.1 million trees and production totaling 361,000 tons. Meanwhile, organic farming and areas under conversion produced 87,000 tons, marking an 11.5 percent decline compared with 2024.Agricultural exports rose 21.5 percent to 614,000 tons, while agricultural crop imports increased 7.7 percent to 20.2 million tons. The report draws on the 2025 Agricultural Survey and administrative records from the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, the Agricultural Development Fund and the Saudi Central Bank.

articles.title: Arab Saudi mengumumkan 50% Saudisasi 17 profesi keuangan mulai Mei 2027
articles.description: RIYADH - Arab Saudi akan mengimplementasikan persyaratan Saudisasi 50 persen di 17 profesi keuangan di sektor swasta, efektif 23 Mei 2027, sebagai bagian dari upaya untuk memperluas peluang kerja bagi pria dan wanita Saudi. Kementerian Sumber Daya Manusia dan Pengembangan Sosial (MHRSD), bekerja sama dengan Organisasi Saudi untuk Akuntan Berjasa dan Profesional (SOCPA), mengatakan bahwa keputusan bertujuan untuk menciptakan kesempatan kerja berkualitas di seluruh Kerajaan dan meningkatkan partisipasi warga negara Saudi di pasar tenaga kerja. Keputusan berlaku untuk swasta - sektor perusahaan mempekerjakan dua atau lebih pekerja dalam profesi yang ditargetkan, sesuai dengan klasifikasi pekerjaan dan persyaratan diuraikan dalam panduan prosedural. 17 profesi yang ditutupi oleh keputusan tersebut termasuk spesialis analisis keuangan, spesialis konsultasi keuangan, manajer investasi, spesialis kontrol keuangan, spesialis perencanaan keuangan, spesialis pengembangan keuangan, spesialis keuangan, manajer keuangan, manajer jasa kredit, penyelidik keuangan, spesialis pendapatan pemerintah, manajer broker keuangan, penasehat investasi, pakar investasi, penasehat keuangan dan ahli keuangan. Pembangunan tertutup oleh keputusan telah diberikan periode enam bulan kasih karunia dari pengumuman untuk mempersiapkan untuk implementasi dan memenuhi persentase Saudisasi yang diperlukan. Departemen ini mendorong lembaga swasta yang terpengaruh untuk meninjau panduan prosedural untuk memahami profesi yang ditargetkan, persyaratan Saudisasi dan metode perhitungan, dan menghindari hukuman dan tindakan hukum yang dihasilkan dari ketidakpatuhan. MHRSD akan menyediakan paket insentif untuk mendukung pembangunan dalam menerapkan keputusan, termasuk perekrutan dan nominasi kandidat Saudi yang memenuhi syarat untuk posisi yang tersedia, pelatihan dan program kualifikasi, dukungan kerja dan bantuan retensi pekerjaan. Pembangunan juga akan menerima akses prioritas untuk program dukungan Saudisasi
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia announces 50% Saudization of 17 financial professions starting May 2027
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia will implement a 50 percent Saudization requirement across 17 financial professions in the private sector, effective May 23, 2027, as part of efforts to expand employment opportunities for Saudi men and women. The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD), in partnership with the Saudi Organization for Chartered and Professional Accountants (SOCPA), said the decision aims to create quality employment opportunities across the Kingdom and increase the participation of Saudi nationals in the labor market. The decision applies to private-sector establishments employing two or more workers in the targeted professions, in accordance with the occupational classifications and requirements outlined in the procedural guide. The 17 professions covered by the decision include financial analysis specialist, financial consulting specialist, investment manager, financial control specialist, investment specialist, financial planning specialist, financial product development specialist, treasury specialist, credit manager, financial services control manager, financial investigator, government revenue specialist, financial brokerage manager, investment adviser, investment expert, financial adviser and financial expert. Establishments covered by the decision have been granted a six-month grace period from its announcement to prepare for implementation and meet the required Saudization percentage. The ministry urged affected private-sector establishments to review the procedural guide to understand the targeted professions, Saudization requirements and calculation methods, and avoid penalties and legal measures resulting from noncompliance. MHRSD will provide a package of incentives to support establishments in implementing the decision, including the recruitment and nomination of qualified Saudi candidates for available positions, training and qualification programs, employment support and job retention assistance. articles.title: Indeks pendapatan operasi Arab Saudi meningkat 12,2% pada bulan September, didorong oleh pertambangan dan aktivitas keuangan
articles.description: RIYADH - indeks pendapatan operasi Arab Saudi meningkat 12,2 persen pada September 2026 dibandingkan dengan bulan yang sama pada tahun 2025, didorong oleh pertumbuhan beberapa aktivitas ekonomi, menurut Otoritas Umum untuk Statistik (GASTAT). Otoritas jangka pendek Bisnis lndicators Statistik Bulletin untuk September 2026, yang melacak kinerja sektor ekonomi melalui indikator bulanan, menunjukkan bahwa pertambangan dan perempatan tumbuh 27,5 persen, diikuti oleh kegiatan keuangan dan asuransi pada 19,3 persen dan produksi pada 15.0 persen. Pertukaran ritel dan sepeda motor dan aktivitas perbaikan juga meningkat sebesar 2,1 persen, sementara konstruksi tumbuh sebesar 0,4 persen. Secara bulanan, indeks pendapatan operasi naik 6,6 persen dibandingkan dengan Agustus 2026, didukung oleh peningkatan 37,3 persen dalam pertambangan dan aktivitas penjajahan dan kenaikan 4 persen dalam kegiatan keuangan dan asuransi. Memproduksi dan kesehatan manusia dan kegiatan kerja sosial masing-masing mencatat peningkatan 3,5 persen, sementara profesional, kegiatan ilmiah dan teknis naik sebesar 1,2 persen. articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia’s operating revenue index rises 12.2% in September, driven by mining and financial activities
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia's operating revenue index increased by 12.2 percent in September 2026 compared with the same month in 2025, driven by growth across several economic activities, according to the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT). The authority's Short-Term Business Indicators Statistics Bulletin for September 2026, which tracks the performance of economic sectors through monthly indicators, showed that mining and quarrying grew by 27.5 percent, followed by financial and insurance activities at 19.3 percent and manufacturing at 15.0 percent. Wholesale and retail trade and motor vehicle repair activities also increased by 2.1 percent, while construction grew by 0.4 percent. On a monthly basis, the operating revenue index rose 6.6 percent compared with August 2026, supported by a 37.3 percent increase in mining and quarrying activities and a 4 percent rise in financial and insurance activities. Manufacturing and human health and social work activities each recorded a 3.5 percent increase, while professional, scientific and technical activities rose by 1.2 percent. The bulletin also showed that the workers' compensation index increased by 6.8 percent in September 2026 compared with the same month in 2025, driven by growth across several economic activities. Manufacturing recorded a 9.4 percent increase, followed by wholesale and retail trade and motor vehicle repair activities at 6.8 percent, financial and insurance activities at 5.6 percent, mining and quarrying at 5.2 percent, and construction at 2 percent. On a monthly basis, the workers' compensation index increased by 0.5 percent compared with August 2026, supported by a 1 percent rise in both financial and insurance activities and transportation and storage activities, while construction increased by 0.8 percent. articles.title: Arab Saudi mengutuk serangan Iran terhadap fasilitas industri sipil di Bahrain, perusahaan solidaritas penuh
articles.description: RIYADH - Arab Saudi sangat mengutuk serangan Iran terhadap fasilitas industri sipil di Bahrain, menegaskan kembali solidaritasnya dengan Bahrain dan dukungannya untuk melindungi keamanan dan stabilitas. Dalam sebuah pernyataan yang dikeluarkan oleh Kementerian Luar Negeri pada hari Minggu, Arab Saudi menyatakan hukumannya dan pengungkapan dalam kondisi terkuat dari serangan Iran menargetkan fasilitas sipil di Bahrain. Kerajaan menegaskan kembali solidaritas penuh dengan Bahrain dalam segala hal diperlukan untuk menjaga keamanan dan stabilitas. Arab Saudi mengulangi penolakan lengkap terhadap tindakan berkelanjutan Iran yang melemahkan keamanan daerah dan stabilitas, termasuk serangan menargetkan negara-negara di wilayah dan fasilitas sipil. Hal ini juga menekankan bahwa tindakan tersebut melanggar prinsip-prinsip hukum internasional, Piagam PBB, Piagam Organisasi Kerjasama Islam dan prinsip-prinsip lingkungan yang baik. Kerajaan itu juga bertanggung jawab atas serangan flagrant terhadap Iran.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia condemns Iranian attack on civilian industrial facility in Bahrain, reaffirms full solidarity
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia strongly condemned Iran’s attacks on a civilian industrial facility in Bahrain, reaffirming its full solidarity with Bahrain and its support for measures taken to protect its security and stability. In a statement issued by Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Sunday, Saudi Arabia expressed its condemnation and denunciation in the strongest terms of the Iranian attacks targeting the civilian facility in Bahrain. The Kingdom reaffirmed its full solidarity with Bahrain in all measures it takes to safeguard its security and stability. Saudi Arabia reiterated its complete rejection of Iran's continued actions that undermine regional security and stability, including attacks targeting countries in the region and civilian facilities. It also stressed that such actions violate the principles of international law, the Charter of the United Nations, the Charter of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation and the principles of good neighborliness. The Kingdom also held Iran responsible for the consequences of its continued flagrant attacks.

articles.title: NCM mengeluarkan peringatan oranye untuk curah hujan di empat daerah Saudi sebagai badai petir tetap diperkirakan
articles.description: JEDDAH - Pusat Nasional Meteorologi (NCM) telah mengeluarkan peringatan oranye untuk curah hujan sedang di daerah Jazan, Asir, Mekah dan daerah Al- Baha pada hari Minggu, saat badai masih diperkirakan di beberapa bagian Arab Saudi. Peringatan oranye yang berlaku dari 1: 00 sampai 8: 00 di Jazan, Asir dan Al- Baha, sementara peringatan untuk Mekah meluas sampai 9: 00 NCM memperingatkan bahwa curah hujan dapat disertai oleh angin kuat, dekat-nol horizontal visibilitas, hujan es, banjir kilat dan petir. Kabut juga mungkin terjadi di sebagian daerah ini, begitu juga daerah pesisir Provinsi Timur.
articles.originalTitle: NCM issues orange alerts for rainfall in four Saudi regions as thunderstorms remain forecast
articles.originalDescription: JEDDAH — The National Center for Meteorology (NCM) has issued orange alerts for moderate rainfall across parts of Jazan, Asir, Makkah and Al-Baha regions on Sunday, as thunderstorms remain forecast across several parts of Saudi Arabia. The orange alerts are in effect from 1 p.m. to 8 p.m. in Jazan, Asir and Al-Baha, while the warning for Makkah extends until 9 p.m. The NCM warned that the rainfall could be accompanied by strong winds, near-zero horizontal visibility, hail, flash floods and lightning. Fog is also possible in parts of these regions, as well as coastal areas of the Eastern Province.

articles.title: Penduduk Israel membakar kendaraan di West Bank, cat 'rasis' grafiti di rumah
articles.description: Penduduk Israel membakar kendaraan-kendaraan di Tepi Barat, melukis graffiti rasis di rumah para pemukim Israel membakar 12 kendaraan milik Palestina dan menyemprot grafiti rasis selama penyerangan tiga desa di Ramallah dan Bireh di wilayah yang dikuasai oleh Bank Barat, media Palestina. Sumber lokal mengatakan bahwa sekelompok pemukim menyerang desa Kafr Malik, timur Ramallah, membakar tujuh kendaraan dan menyemprot slogan rasis di dinding beberapa rumah. Dalam serangan terpisah, penjajah menyerbu kota Deir Abu Mash 'al, barat laut Ramallah, membakar tiga kendaraan dan menyemprotkan grafiti rasis sebelum meninggalkan daerah tersebut. Di Deir Al- Sudan, utara Ramallah, koloni membakar dua kendaraan milik dua warga Palestina, menyebabkan kerusakan material yang luas. Polisi Israel, menurut Haaretz, mengatakan mereka telah membuka penyelidikan terhadap pembakaran, grafiti dan kerusakan properti di empat situs di Tepi Barat. Pemimpin partai Yashar Gadi Eisenkot mengutuk serangan tersebut, menyebut mereka "teroris Yahudi" dan memperingatkan kelompok ekstremis membakar kendaraan dan rumah-rumah mendorong West Bank menuju "anarki". articles.originalTitle: Israeli settlers torch vehicles in West Bank, paint 'racist' graffiti on homes
articles.originalDescription: Israeli settlers torch vehicles in West Bank, paint 'racist' graffiti on homes Israeli settlers set fire to 12 Palestinian-owned vehicles and spray-painted racist graffiti during attacks on three villages in Ramallah and al-Bireh in the occupied West Bank, Palestinian media reported. Local sources told Wafa that a group of settlers attacked the village of Kafr Malik, east of Ramallah, setting fire to seven vehicles and spray-painting racist slogans on the walls of some homes. In a separate attack, colonists raided the town of Deir Abu Mash'al, northwest of Ramallah, setting fire to three vehicles and spraying racist graffiti before fleeing the area. In Deir al-Sudan, north of Ramallah, colonists set fire to two vehicles belonging to two Palestinian citizens, causing extensive material damage. Israeli police, according to Haaretz, said they had opened an investigation into arson, graffiti and property damage at four sites in the West Bank. Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot condemned the attacks, calling them "Jewish terrorism" and warning that extremist groups setting fire to vehicles and homes were pushing the West Bank toward "anarchy." Israeli settler militias set fire to several Palestinian vehicles in the village of Kafr Malik, east of Ramallah, in the occupied West Bank, in the early hours of Sunday. https://t.co/Rvh60XZpXN — Quds News Network (@QudsNen) November 22, 2026

articles.title: Pendiri World Central Kitchen mengatakan tiga tewas dalam serangan Gaza 'bukan bagian dari tim kami'
articles.description: Pendiri World Central Kitchen mengatakan tiga tewas dalam serangan Gaza 'bukan bagian dari tim kami' Pendiri World Central Kitchen, Jose Andres, mengatakan bahwa ketiga orang yang tewas dalam serangan Israel pada kendaraan yang memberikan bantuan makanan di Gaza, tidak termasuk organisasi, juga kendaraan. articles.originalTitle: World Central Kitchen founder says three killed in Gaza strike 'not part of our team'
articles.originalDescription: World Central Kitchen founder says three killed in Gaza strike 'not part of our team' The founder of the World Central Kitchen, Jose Andres, has said that the three people killed in an Israeli strike on a vehicle delivering food aid in Gaza, did not belong the organisation, nor did the vehicle. In a post on X, Andres said, "Early reports linked them to World Central Kitchen. They were not part of our team, and it was not our vehicle. That's all we know." "But here is what I do know. More than a year into a ceasefire, people in Gaza are still dying. Families are facing a fourth winter in tents," he added. The Israeli army had earlier claimed in a post on X that it targeted three “Islamic Jihad terrorists” in a vehicle used to transport food and supplies to other group operatives in Gaza. Andres added that a "ceasefire is not peace", calling upon leaders to work towards ending the conflict. "To every leader with the power to change this, on every side: finish the work. End this war for good, so Palestinians and Israelis can live in safety, and so the people of Gaza can start to rebuild their homes, their schools, their kitchens," he said. "Our teams, Gazans feeding Gazans, were cooking again today. They will be there tomorrow. A plate of food is hope. But it is not a future. Peace is."
