articles.title: Pro- Israel Hakeem Jeffries mengatakan ia akan mendorong undang-undang menargetkan kekerasan pemukim
articles.description: Israel Hakeem Jeffries mengatakan dia akan mendorong undang-undang untuk menargetkan kekerasan... Pro- pemimpin Demokrat AS, Hakeem Jeffries, yang diharapkan menjadi pembicara hitam pertama dari Dewan Perwakilan tahun depan, telah berjanji untuk memajukan undang-undang menargetkan kekerasan penduduk Israel... dalam pendudukan Bank Barat dalam 100 hari pertama Kongres baru. Dalam sebuah wawancara dengan The New York Times, Jeffries mengatakan Undang-Undang Perlindungan Kekerasan dan Penakluk Bank Barat harus menjadi salah satu prioritas awal legislatif, menambahkan bahwa ia mengharapkan dukungan yang kuat untuk itu dalam House Demokrat Caucus. Jeffries juga menggambarkan kehancuran yang ditimbulkan pada warga Palestina di Gaza sebagai "tidak dapat diterima, tidak berkelanjutan dan tidak-Amerika", menyerukan peningkatan bantuan kemanusiaan, bantuan medis, dukungan perumahan dan akses ke air bersih dan udara. Tanyakan apakah ia mendukung Block yang diusulkan Bom dan Hentikan tagihan Settlement, yang panggilan untuk membatasi penjualan senjata untuk Israel dan sanksi lebih luas pada ekspansi penyelesaian, Jeffries mengatakan ia tidak mengambil posisi. Pada panggilan untuk menghentikan ekspor senjata AS yang digunakan dalam konflik regional, dia mengatakan pendekatan saat ini adalah "tidak berkelanjutan" dan diperlukan untuk berubah. Lebih dari satu juta orang telah menandatangani petisi mendesak Demokrat untuk menolak Hasem Jeffries sebagai Ketua Dewan Perwakilan AS berikutnya. Sebuah polling Ekonomi / YouGov diterbitkan bulan lalu menemukan bahwa Jeffries hanya memiliki 26 persen peringkat persetujuan di antara pemilih yang terdaftar. Kritik mengatakan bahwa satu alasan popularitas Jeffries 'telah terkena pukulan adalah bahwa ia adalah pendukung setia Israel. Komite Urusan Publik Israel Amerika (Aipac) jajaran di antara kontributor top-nya. Jeffries bilang dia mengharapkan dukungan kuat untuk West Bank Settler Protection and Prevention Act (AFP)
articles.originalTitle: Pro-Israel Hakeem Jeffries says he will push legislation targeting settler violence
articles.originalDescription: Pro-Israel Hakeem Jeffries says he will push legislation targeting settler violence Pro-Israel US Democratic leader, Hakeem Jeffries, who is expected to become the first Black speaker of the House of Representatives next year, has pledged to advance legislation targeting Israeli settler violence in the occupied West Bank within the first 100 days of the new Congress. In an interview with The New York Times, Jeffries said the West Bank Settler Violence Protection and Prevention Act should be among the early legislative priorities, adding that he expected strong support for it within the House Democratic Caucus. Jeffries also described the devastation inflicted on Palestinian civilians in Gaza as “unacceptable, unsustainable and un-American”, calling for increased humanitarian assistance, medical aid, housing support and access to clean water and air. Asked whether he supported the proposed Block the Bombs and Stop the Settlements bills, which call for restricting arms sale to Israel and broader sanctions on settlement expansion, Jeffries said he had not taken a position. On calls to halt US weapons exports used in regional conflicts, he said the current approach was “not sustainable” and needed to change. More than a million people have signed a petition urging Democrats to reject Hakeem Jeffries as the next Speaker of the US House of Representative. An Economist/YouGov poll published last month found that Jeffries had just a 26 percent approval rating among registered voters. Critics say that one reason Jeffries' popularity has taken a hit is that he is an avid supporter of Israel. The American Israel Public Affairs Committee (Aipac) ranks among his top campaign-financing contributors. Jeffries said he expects strong support for the West Bank Settler Violence Protection and Prevention Act. (AFP)

articles.title: Menteri luar negeri Turki mengatakan perang Iran jatuh mengancam pasar global
articles.description: Menteri luar negeri Turki mengatakan perang Iran menghancurkan pasar global Turkish Fidan mengatakan bahwa beban ekonomi yang dibawa oleh Amerika Serikat semakin sulit bagi banyak negara, sementara menekankan gencatan senjata diperlukan untuk membalikkan krisis keuangan global. Berbicara dengan penyiar Turki TGRT Haber pada hari Sabtu, Fidan memperingatkan bahwa kejatuhan dari konflik mengancam pasar internasional. "Ini menuju ke arah memiliki efek yang sangat merusak", katanya. Fidan mengatakan upaya diplomatik untuk membuka Selat Hormuz tetap aktif, meskipun proses tampaknya akan mati, mengutip diskusi terakhirnya dengan Perdana Menteri Qatar Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani. Dia juga mengatakan bahwa Ankara adalah menjaga krisis kemanusiaan di Gaza pada radar global secara permanen meskipun krisis internasional lainnya. "Dalam setiap pidato, setiap inisiatif, dan setiap platform mana pun itu mungkin, masalah Gaza adalah satu kita tidak, dan tidak akan, memungkinkan dilupakan," Kata Fidan.
articles.originalTitle: Turkish foreign minister says Iran war fallout threatening global markets
articles.originalDescription: Turkish foreign minister says Iran war fallout threatening global markets Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan has said the economic burden brought by the US-Israel war is getting harder for many countries, while emphasising a ceasefire was needed to reverse global financial crises. Speaking to Turkish broadcaster TGRT Haber on Saturday, Fidan warned that the fallout from the conflict is threatening international markets. “It is heading toward having very destructive effects,” he said. Fidan said diplomatic efforts to re-open the Strait of Hormuz remain active, even though the process appears to be deadlocked, citing his recent discussion with Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani. He also said that Ankara was keeping the humanitarian crisis in Gaza on the global radar permanently despite other international crises. "In every speech, every initiative, and every platform wherever it may be, the Gaza issue is one we have not, and will not, allow to be forgotten," Fidan said.

articles.originalDescription: Turkey says Israel blocking thousands of container homes from entering Gaza Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan has said Israel is blocking thousands of container homes destined for Gaza, adding that Israeli authorities argue Hamas could use the metal structures for manufacturing weapons. articles.originalTitle: Hind Rajab Foundation urges Germany to arrest Israeli soldier over Gaza war crimes
articles.originalDescription: Hind Rajab Foundation urges Germany to arrest Israeli soldier over Gaza war crimes The Hind Rajab Foundation (HRF) has urged Germany to arrest an Israeli soldier, Almog Keisi, who has been sighted in Luneburg this week, accusing him of war crimes, crimes against humanity and acts of genocide in Gaza. In a statement, the foundation said it filed a criminal complaint with Germany’s Federal Public Prosecutor in Karlsruhe under the principle of universal jurisdiction set out in Section 1 of the German Code of Crimes against International Law that cover genocide, crimes against humanity, and war crimes. German authorities can exercise jurisdiction over these offences regardless of the suspect’s nationality or where the alleged crimes were committed, the statement read. HRF said that Keisi participated in the burning of residential buildings in Gaza City’s Sheikh Radwan neighbourhood between 9 and 10 October 2025, following the announcement of a ceasefire agreement and ahead of Israeli forces’ withdrawal from northern Gaza. According to the complaint, Keisi posted photographs on 10 October showing himself placing explosives around civilian objects and later posing in front of buildings engulfed in flames. Other soldiers from the Givati Brigade also shared photographs of the burning structures, describing the destruction as a celebratory farewell. HRF said it had geolocated the buildings near Al-Mawhobeen Secondary Female School and cited NASA fire-detection data and satellite imagery as corroborating evidence of the fires and damage. Dyab Abou Jahjah, HRF’s general director, said: “Germany has received evidence against suspected war criminals before and chose to look away. Meanwhile, it arrests and prosecutes people for waving keffiyehs or chanting slogans against the genocide." articles.originalDescription: Houthi attacks kill one civilian killed, injure seven in Taiz, Yemen government says Houthi attacks on the besieged city of Taiz killed one person and wounded at least seven others, Yemen’s Office for Siege Affairs said. The office said shelling hit an ambulance in the southern district of Sabr al-Muamad, killing one person and wounding six. The ambulance was reportedly taking part in an operation to rescue an injured civilian when it was hit. Houthi snipers separately wounded a 20-year-old woman in al-Quhaf, south of the city, the office said. Smoke billows from a site that was targeted during battles between Saudi-aligned Yemeni government fighters and Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis at the Jabal Han front, west of the city of Taiz, on 21 October 2026 (AFP)

articles.title: Perintah pengiriman meningkat 25% lebih dari 129 juta di Q3 2026
articles.description: RIYADH - Otoritas Umum Transportasi (TGA) mengatakan bahwa perintah pengiriman di Arab Saudi melampaui 129 juta pada kuartal ketiga 2026, menandai peningkatan 25,2 persen dibandingkan dengan periode yang sama pada 2025. Pertumbuhan mencerminkan peningkatan permintaan layanan pengiriman dan peningkatan ketergantungan pada aplikasi pengiriman di seluruh Kingdom. Menurut buletin statistik otoritas triwulanan, Riyadh menghitung pesanan pengiriman terbesar pada 44 persen, diikuti oleh Mekah wilayah 22 persen, Provinsi Timur 16persen, Madinah Daerah 5 persen, dan Asir region4 persen. Qassim menghitung 3 persen permintaan total, sementara Tabuk dan Hail masing-masing tercatat 2 persen. Al- Jouf, Borders Utara, Jazan, dan Najran masing-masing menghitung satu persen sementara Al- Baha tercatat 0.28 persen. Pihak berwenang menegaskan kembali komitmennya untuk mengembangkan sektor pengiriman, meningkatkan efisiensi operasional, dan meningkatkan kualitas layanan. Upaya ini bertujuan untuk mendukung pertumbuhan sektor dan keberlanjutan dan memperkuat keandalan layanan pengiriman di seluruh Kingdom.
articles.originalTitle: Delivery orders surge 25% to over 129 million in Q3 2026
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Transport General Authority (TGA) said that delivery orders in Saudi Arabia exceeded 129 million in the third quarter of 2026, marking a 25.2 percent increase compared to the same period in 2025. The growth reflects rising demand for delivery services and increased reliance on delivery applications across the Kingdom.According to the authority’s quarterly statistical bulletin, Riyadh accounted for the largest share of delivery orders at 44 percent, followed by Makkah region 22 percent, Eastern Province 16percent, Madinah region 5 percent , and Asir region4 percent. Qassim accounted for 3 percent of total requests, while Tabuk and Hail each recorded 2 percent. Al-Jouf, Northern Borders, Jazan, and Najran each accounted for one percent while Al-Baha recorded 0.28 percent.The authority reaffirmed its commitment to developing the delivery sector, enhancing operational efficiency, and improving service quality. These efforts aim to support the sector’s growth and sustainability and strengthen the reliability of delivery services across the Kingdom.

Dia menekankan bahwa komitmen Kerajaan tak tergoyahkan untuk mempertahankan keamanan nasionalnya, mempertahankan keamanan dan stabilitas Teluk, dan melindungi jalur air penting Selat Hormuz dan Bab al- Selat Mandab meluas jauh melampaui wilayah, melayani kepentingan seluruh dunia. Radwan membuat pernyataan sambil menyampaikan sesi berjudul "Redefine Security: Iran, Selat, dan Masa Depan Perintah Regional" di Dialogues Mediterania (MED) konferensi di Naples, Italia. Dia meminta arsitektur keamanan regional yang berkelanjutan di mana setiap keamanan negara terkait dengan tetangganya dan tidak mencapai biaya orang lain, yang didirikan pada jaminan keamanan bersama, sehingga akhir dari satu putaran konflik tidak hanya mengatur panggung untuk yang lebih kejam. "Pengaturan sementara tidak akan bekerja kecuali mereka selaras dengan jangka panjang strategi frameworks. Berurusan dengan kelompok bersenjata di luar kontrol negara memerlukan visi politik, bukan hanya satu keamanan, yang menangani penyebab lokal munculnya mereka dan link mereka ke pihak eksternal yang mendukung dan mengeksploitasi mereka," katanya. articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia calls for mutual guarantees for lasting regional security at Mediterranean Dialogues
articles.originalDescription: NAPLES — Advisor and Special Envoy of the Minister of Foreign Affairs for Negotiations and Peace Efforts Manal Radwan affirmed that Saudi Arabia remains steadfast in pursuing a balanced strategy that combines containment, deterrence, and dialogue to safeguard regional peace and stability. She emphasized that the Kingdom’s unwavering commitment to defending its national security, preserving the security and stability of the Gulf, and protecting the vital waterways of the Strait of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab Strait extends far beyond the region, serving the interests of the entire world. Radwan made the remarks while addressing a session titled "Redefining Security: Iran, the Straits, and the Future of the Regional Order" at the Mediterranean Dialogues (MED) conference in Naples, Italy. She called for a sustainable regional security architecture in which each state's security is linked to that of its neighbors and not achieved at another's expense, founded on mutual security guarantees, so that the end of one round of conflict does not merely set the stage for a more violent one. “Temporary arrangements will not work unless they are aligned with long-term strategic frameworks. articles.title: Arab Saudi mendeportasi 11.915 warga ilegal dalam seminggu
articles.description: RIYADH - otoritas keamanan Saudi menangkap 10,783 warga ilegal dalam seminggu. Penangkapan dilakukan dalam pemeriksaan bersama, dilakukan oleh pasukan keamanan dalam kolaborasi dengan lembaga-lembaga pemerintah yang relevan, selama periode antara 12 November dan 18, Kementerian Dalam Negeri diumumkan pada hari Sabtu. Mereka yang ditangkap termasuk 5.718 pelanggar Hukum Residensi, 2.797 pelanggar Hukum Keamanan Perbatasan, dan 2.268 pelanggar Hukum Tenaga Kerja. Total penduduk ilegal 11.915 dideportasi sementara 23.250 pelanggar disebut misi diplomatik mereka untuk mendapatkan dokumen perjalanan dan 10,814 pelanggar disebut untuk menyelesaikan pemesanan perjalanan mereka. Jumlah total orang yang ditangkap saat mencoba untuk menyeberangi perbatasan ke Kingdom terhitung 1.373. Total 28 orang ditangkap saat mencoba meninggalkan Kerajaan secara ilegal. Beberapa 14 orang terlibat dalam memberikan transportasi, tempat tinggal, dan pekerjaan untuk pelanggar juga ditangkap. Total ekspatriat 40.941, termasuk 38.730 pria dan 2.211 perempuan, saat ini menjalani prosedur untuk melakukan tindakan hukum untuk pelanggaran. Kementerian Dalam Negeri telah memperingatkan bahwa setiap orang, yang memfasilitasi entri ilegal individu ke Kerajaan, mengangkut mereka di wilayahnya, menyediakan tempat tinggal atau bantuan atau jasa lainnya, akan dihukum hingga 15 tahun penjara dan denda hingga SR1 juta, dan kendaraan yang digunakan untuk transportasi atau rumah yang digunakan untuk memberikan perlindungan akan disita. Menteri mendesak publik untuk melaporkan setiap kasus pelanggaran dengan menelepon nomor 911 di daerah Mekah, Riyadh, dan Provinsi Timur dan nomor 999 dan 996 di sisa wilayah Kerajaan.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia deports 11,915 illegal residents in a week
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi security authorities arrested a total of 10,783 illegal residents in a week. The arrests were made in the joint inspections, carried out by the security forces in collaboration with the relevant government agencies, during the period between November 12 and 18, the Ministry of Interior announced on Saturday. Those who were arrested include 5,718 violators of the Residency Law, 2,797 violators of the Border Security Law, and 2,268 violators of the Labor Law. A total of 11,915 illegal residents were deported while 23,250 violators were referred to their diplomatic missions to obtain travel documents and 10,814 violators were referred to complete their travel reservations. The total number of people who were arrested while trying to cross the border into the Kingdom accounted for 1,373. A total of 28 people were arrested while attempting to leave the Kingdom illegally. Some 14 people involved in giving transportation, shelter, and employment for violators were also arrested. A total of 40,941 expatriates, including 38,730 men and 2,211 women, are currently undergoing procedures to enforce legal measures for violations. The Ministry of Interior has warned that any person, who facilitates the illegal entry of individuals into the Kingdom, transports them on its territory, provides them with shelter or any other assistance or service, will be penalized with up to 15 years in prison and a fine of up to SR1 million, and that the vehicles used for transportation or houses used for giving shelter will be confiscated. The ministry urged the public to report any cases of violation by calling the number 911 in the regions of Makkah, Riyadh, and the Eastern Province and the numbers 999 and 996 in the rest of the Kingdom’s regions.

articles.originalTitle: 'Will throw keys back to UN': Trump-appointed Board of Peace adviser says Israel blocking efforts

articles.title: Investor asing menyuntikkan SR786 juta ke dalam 131 Saudi-terdaftar perusahaan
articles.description: RIYADH - Investor asing membeli total 34,9 juta saham, dihargai sekitar SR786 juta, pada Pertukaran Saham Saudi (Tadabul). Menurut laporan perubahan kepemilikan asing, meliputi minggu perdagangan berakhir November 19, kepemilikan mereka meningkat 131 perusahaan terdaftar pada Tadaul. Sementara itu, investor asing mengurangi kepemilikan mereka pada 197 perusahaan lain dengan menjual 53.3 juta saham senilai sekitar SR929 juta. Kepemilikan mereka tetap tidak berubah di 71 perusahaan lain. Indeks utama pasar saham Saudi, Tadabul, mengakhiri minggu dengan 167,6 poin, atau 1,6 persen, dari minggu sebelumnya, menutup pada 10,158,9 poin. Sementara itu, indeks pasar paralel, Nomu, ditolak 337.72 poin, atau 1,5 persen, selama periode yang sama, penutupan pada 21.716.4 poin.
articles.originalTitle: Foreign investors inject SR786 million into 131 Saudi-listed companies
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Foreign investors purchased a total of 34.9 million shares, valued at approximately SR786 million, on the Saudi Stock Exchange (Tadawul). According to a report on changes in foreign ownership, covering the trading week ended November 19, their holdings increased in 131 companies listed on Tadawul. Meanwhile, foreign investors reduced their holdings in 197 other companies by selling 53.3 million shares worth approximately SR929 million. Their ownership remained unchanged in 71 other companies. The Saudi stock market’s main index, Tadawul, ended the week down 167.6 points, or 1.6 percent, from the previous week, closing at 10,158.9 points. Meanwhile, the parallel market index, Nomu, declined by 337.72 points, or 1.5 percent, over the same period, closing at 21,716.4 points.

articles.title: Serangan Israel segar di Gaza membunuh tiga
articles.description: Serangan baru Israel di Gaza membunuh tiga orang Palestina yang terbunuh oleh serangan udara Israel pada sebuah kendaraan di Gaza City 's Tel-al Hawa lingkungan pada hari Sabtu. Serangan tersebut, yang dilaporkan oleh badan berita Wafa dan dikonfirmasikan oleh wartawan Al Jazeera yang tinggal di enclave, juga melukai beberapa orang. Lebih dari 1.600 warga Palestina telah terbunuh oleh serangan Israel yang sedang berlangsung sejak persetujuan gencatan senjata Oktober 2025 antara Perdana Menteri Benjamin Netanyahu dan Hamas, dengan total korban kematian Palestina di wilayah tersebut sejak Oktober 2023 melebihi 74.000.
articles.originalTitle: Fresh Israeli attack on Gaza kills three
articles.originalDescription: Fresh Israeli attack on Gaza kills three Three Palestinians were killed by an Israeli air strike on a vehicle in Gaza City's Tel-al Hawa neighbourhood on Saturday. The attack, which was reported by the Wafa news agency and corroborated by Al Jazeera reporters based in the enclave, also injured several people. Over 1,600 Palestinians have been killed by ongoing Israeli attacks since the October 2025 ceasefire agreement between Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's government and Hamas, with the total Palestinian death toll in the enclave since October 2023 exceeding 74,000.

articles.originalTitle: Explosive-laden boxes dropped from the sky: Israel’s latest weapon in Gaza
articles.originalDescription: Explosive-laden boxes dropped from the sky: Israel’s latest weapon in Gaza Submitted by Abdallah al-Naami on Fri, 11/20/2026 - 12:08 Palestinian families recount how Israeli quadcopters drop explosives on to their homes, demolishing entire buildings and displacing dozens of families Jaber Yaseen stands amid the rubble of his home, destroyed by explosive-laden boxes dropped by an Israeli drone in Gaza City’s al-Zaytoon neighbourhood (Abdallah al-Naami/MEE) Off Jaber Yaseen's family was preparing the traditional maftoul dish for their Friday family lunch when they heard a loud engine approaching. The Palestinian family of 13 were startled by the noise, which grew louder as it approached their home in al-Zaytoon neighbourhood, east of Gaza City. “I thought it was an Israeli tank at first. I looked out of the window and was shocked to see a huge quadcopter drone carrying two boxes of explosives, flying low over our neighbourhood,” Yaseen told Middle East Eye. “I watched the drone move towards us. Without any warning, it dropped the two boxes of explosives on to our roof. I was terrified for my children's lives. I grabbed them and rushed out of the house, knowing the explosives could detonate at any moment. We couldn't take anything with us.” Panic spread as families watched more Israeli drones dropping explosives on to rooftops across the neighbourhood. Dozens were forced to flee their homes, with nowhere to go. A group of residents gathered at a distance, watching as the quadcopter drones continued to drop explosives. Minutes later, the devices on the rooftops began detonating. For 33-year-old Ismail Madi, watching the drones was heartbreaking. “We had been displaced several times before, and each time I held on to some hope that we would return home. But when I saw the quadcopter drones carrying explosives above our home, I felt as though I had left my soul behind as I walked away,” Madi told MEE. articles.title: Aktivis Pro-Palestina Fergie Chambers dibebaskan, mengatakan 'pengorbananku sangat kecil'
articles.description: Aktivis ProPalestina Fergie Chambers dibebaskan, mengatakan 'pengorbananku sangat kecil' Pengadilan Tinggi Spanyol telah merilis pro- aktivis Palestina dan ahli waris media AS Fergie Chambers dengan jaminan kondisional, sementara mempertimbangkan permintaan ekstradisi oleh AS, menurut putusan pengadilan dirilis pada hari Jumat. Pengadilan memutuskan untuk membebaskan Chambers setelah pihak berwenang AS mengakui apa yang mereka deskripsikan sebagai kesalahan substansial dan tidak disengaja dalam terjemahan Spanyol pernyataan sumpah seorang agen FBI diajukan dalam mendukung permintaan ekstradisi. Pada rilis, Chambers mengatakan kepada Reuters ia percaya tuduhan terhadap dirinya tidak berdasar dan politik termotivasi, menambahkan bahwa ia telah sendirian di sel untuk apa "merasa seperti waktu yang lama". "Saya senang bahwa ini adalah langkah ke arah yang benar", katanya. Chambers menambahkan: "Pada akhirnya, saya mengerti bahwa sebagian besar pengorbanan yang harus saya buat sangat, sangat kecil dalam hubungannya dengan perjuangan bahwa kita semua bagian dari rakyat Palestina, untuk pembebasan mereka, untuk kedaulatan mereka, untuk penghormatan mereka, untuk hak untuk hidup". "Tapi dalam konteks hanya sendirian dalam sel sepanjang waktu, rasanya seperti waktu yang lama. Aku hanya merindukan keluargaku. Saya sangat merindukan keluarga dan teman-teman saya", kata Chambers. Chambers, yang keluarganya memiliki Cox Enterprises, ditangkap atas permintaan otoritas AS pada tanggal 10 Juli saat berlibur di Ibiza. Dia telah ditahan sejak tuduhan termasuk kerusuhan, konspirasi untuk melakukan kerusuhan dan pencucian uang internasional. Chambers, yang nama lengkapnya adalah James Cox Chambers Jr, menyangkal kesalahan. Pengacara Chambers bilang mereka menantang serangan oleh polisi Irlandia di rumah keluarganya di Dublin, yang katanya dilakukan atas permintaan otoritas AS dan melibatkan penyitaan perangkat elektronik dan properti lainnya. articles.originalTitle: Pro-Palestine activist Fergie Chambers released, says 'my sacrifice is very small'
articles.originalDescription: Pro-Palestine activist Fergie Chambers released, says 'my sacrifice is very small' Spain's High Court has released pro-Palestinian activist and US media heir Fergie Chambers on conditional bail, while it considers an extradition request by the US, according to a court ruling released on Friday. The court said it had decided to release Chambers after US authorities acknowledged what they described as substantial and unintentional errors in the Spanish translation of an FBI agent's sworn statement submitted in support of the extradition request. On his release, Chambers told Reuters he believed the accusations against him were baseless and politically motivated, adding that he had been alone in a cell for what "felt like a long time". "I'm glad that this is a step in the right direction," he said. Chambers added: "At the end of the day, I understand that most of the sacrifice I've had to make is very, very small in relation to the struggle that we are all a part of for the Palestinian people, for their liberation, for their sovereignty, for their respect, for the right to live." "But in the context of just being alone in a cell all the time, it feels like a long time. I just missed my family. I really missed my family and my friends,” Chambers said. Chambers, whose family owns Cox Enterprises, was arrested at the request of US authorities on 10 July while on holiday in Ibiza. He has been held in custody ever since on accusations including riot, conspiracy to commit riot and international money laundering. Chambers, whose full name is James Cox Chambers Jr, denies wrongdoing. Separately, Chambers' lawyers said they were challenging a raid by Irish police on his family home in Dublin, which they said was conducted at the request of US authorities and involved the seizure of electronic devices and other property. articles.originalDescription: Seven Gazans wounded, one critically, in Israeli gunfire and airstrikes Seven Palestinians were injured, one of them critically, in Israeli gunfire and airstrikes across Gaza on Saturday morning, Wafa reported. articles.originalTitle: Israeli gunfire injures woman, child in Khan Younis area of Gaza
articles.originalDescription: Israeli gunfire injures woman, child in Khan Younis area of Gaza A woman and child were hit by Israeli gunfire in an area outside Israeli control, south of Khan Younis, Al Jazeera reported, citing Nasser Medical Complex in southern Gaza. Earlier, APF reported that six Palestinians were killed in Israeli strikes on the enclave, which came a day after the army said it had completed a ground incursion in the central Gaza Strip.

articles.title: Kelompok hak panggilan untuk larangan fosfor putih, mengutip penggunaan Israel di Gaza
articles.description: Kelompok hak asasi menyerukan larangan fosfor putih, mengutip penggunaan Israel di kelompok hak-hak Gaza, Maat for Peace, Development and Human Rights, telah menyerukan larangan eksplisit atas penggunaan fosfor putih, yang telah berulang kali digunakan oleh Israel di Gaza dan Lebanon selatan, Al Jazeera melaporkan. Fosfor putih dapat menyebabkan luka bakar yang parah, terbakar berulang kali dan menghasilkan panas yang intens dan asap beracun. Kelompok hak asasi manusia dan The New York Times mengatakan pada bulan Juni mereka telah mendokumentasikan penggunaan Israel dari chemical white fosfor di daerah sipil Lebanon. Fosfor putih tidak dilarang di bawah hukum internasional, tetapi adalah ilegal untuk menggunakan bahan kimia di dan dekat daerah penduduk karena dapat menyebabkan kerusakan luas. Israel telah dituduh oleh komunitas hak asasi manusia internasional selama beberapa dekade menggunakan zat tersebut dengan cara yang membahayakan warga sipil. Dalam kertas kerja yang diajukan pada sesi tinjauan untuk Konvensi PBB pada Senjata Konvensi tertentu, kelompok mengatakan perjanjian saat ini telah melotot celah yang memungkinkan untuk penggunaan fosfor putih. Setelah penusukan setelah pembicaraan dimulai pada hari Senin, konferensi berjalan dari waktu ke waktu dan berakhir lebih awal pada hari Sabtu, dengan negara-negara setuju untuk terus berbicara ditujukan pada langkah-langkah mengembangkan senjata otonom mematikan pada tahun 2028.
articles.originalTitle: Rights group calls for ban on white phosphorus, cites Israel's use in Gaza
articles.originalDescription: Rights group calls for ban on white phosphorus, cites Israel's use in Gaza Cairo-based rights group, Maat for Peace, Development and Human Rights, has called for an explicit ban on the use of white phosphours, which has repeatedly been used by Israel in Gaza and southern Lebanon, Al Jazeera reported. White phosphorus can cause severe burns, ignite repeatedly and produce intense heat and toxic smoke. Human rights groups and The New York Times said in June they have documented Israel's use of the chemical white phosphorus over civilian areas in Lebanon. White phosphorus is not banned under international law, but it is illegal to use the chemical in and near populated areas since it can cause widespread harm. Israel has been accused by the international human rights community for decades of using the substance in a way that puts civilians in danger. In a working paper submitted at the review session for the UN Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons, the group said the current treaty has glaring gaps that allow for the use of white phosphorus. Following an impasse after talks started on Monday, the conference ran over time and ended early on Saturday, with states agreeing to continue talks aimed at developing measures on lethal autonomous weapons by 2028.

articles.title: Gaza Board of Peace mengatakan itu akan memberikan kunci kepada PBB jika Israel gagal untuk menghormati komitmen
articles.description: Gaza Board of Peace mengatakan akan memberikan kunci kepada PBB jika Israel gagal untuk menghormati komitmen Seorang penasihat senior Trump- diangkat Gaza Dewan Perdamaian telah memperingatkan bahwa tubuh bisa kembali tanggung jawab untuk masuk ke PBB jika Israel tidak menghormati komitmennya di bawah rencana 20 - titik, Israel outlet Ynet telah melaporkan. Josh Gruenbaum, yang ditunjuk dewan oleh Trump dan sebelumnya bekerja di Gedung Putih, mengatakan kepada Ynet: "Kami telah sangat sabar dan telah memberikan Israel ruang. Tapi itu membuat frustasi bahwa sekarang dengan pemilu di belakang kami - bahkan jika mereka belum menghasilkan koalisi yang jelas - bahwa Israel gagal untuk bergerak maju pada komitmen Netanyahu dibuat untuk Presiden Trump." "Jika kepemimpinan politik ini mengatakan tidak lagi ingin menghormati apa yang mereka berkomitmen untuk, biarkan kami tahu", kata Gruenbaum "Dan kami akan melemparkan kunci kembali ke PBB". Ynet mengatakan telah melihat presentasi yang disiapkan oleh anggota dewan, yang mengunjungi Israel minggu lalu. Slide terakhir, berjudul "alternatif lain untuk Gaza", dilaporkan daftar beberapa skenario jika rencananya ditinggalkan. Ini termasuk administrasi dan Kongres AS masa depan yang memesan rencana rekonstruksi yang berbeda, Dewan Keamanan PBB mengambil alih "mungkin melalui UNRWA", Otoritas Palestina dan Hamas. Skenario terakhir, menurut slide, adalah Israel menjadi sepenuhnya bertanggung jawab atas biaya administrasi dan kemanusiaan penduduk Gaza. Slide lainnya dilaporkan mengatakan Hamas secara resmi menerima rencana tersebut pada bulan Juli, berjanji untuk menyerahkan senjata dan mentransfer kekuatan pemerintah kepada Komite Nasional untuk Administrasi Gaza (NCAG), tubuh teknologi yang dimaksudkan untuk menjalankan wilayah tersebut. "Kami terhenti karena unsur-unsur politik dalam pemerintah Netanyahu yang telah mencegah kami dari kemajuan dan dari pengujian apakah Hamas akan menepati janjinya", kata Gruenbaum, menurut Ynet. G
articles.originalTitle: Gaza Board of Peace says it will hand keys to UN if Israel fails to honour commitments
articles.originalDescription: Gaza Board of Peace says it will hand keys to UN if Israel fails to honour commitments A senior adviser to the Trump-appointed Gaza Peace Council has warned that the body could return responsibility for the enclave to the United Nations if Israel does not honour its commitments under the 20-point plan, Israeli outlet Ynet has reported. Josh Gruenbaum, who was appointed to the council by Trump and previously worked in the White House, told Ynet: “We have been extremely patient and have given Israel its space. But it is frustrating that now with the elections behind us — even if they haven’t resulted in a clear coalition — that Israel is failing to move forward on the commitments Netanyahu made to President Trump.” “If this political leadership says it no longer wants to honour what they committed to, just let us know,” Gruenbaum said “And we will throw the keys back to the UN.” Ynet said it had seen a presentation prepared by council members, who visited Israel last week. Its final slide, titled “Other alternatives to Gaza”, reportedly lists several scenarios if the plan is abandoned. These include a future US administration and Congress ordering a different reconstruction plan, the UN Security Council taking over “perhaps through UNRWA”, the Palestinian Authority and Hamas. The last scenario, according to the slide, is that Israel becomes fully responsible for the administrative and humanitarian costs of Gaza’s population. Another slide reportedly says Hamas formally accepted the plan in July, pledging to give up its weapons and transfer governmental powers to the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza (NCAG), the technocratic body meant to run the territory. “We are at a standstill due to political elements within the Netanyahu government who have prevented us from progressing and from testing whether Hamas will keep its word,” Gruenbaum said, according to Ynet. Gruenbaum also criticises Israel for failing to allow sufficient aid into Gaza before winter

articles.title: Israel tidak melakukan panggilan untuk melindungi petani zaitun Palestina, kata Ocha
articles.description: Israel tidak melakukan panggilan untuk melindungi petani zaitun Palestina, Ocha mengatakan bahwa panggilan kepada pihak berwenang Israel untuk melindungi para petani zaitun Palestina dan memastikan mereka dapat mencapai padang rumput mereka dengan aman belum dilakukan, Kantor PBB untuk koordinasi Urusan Kemanusiaan (Ocha) mengatakan, mengutip Tim Negara Kemanusiaan. Sebaliknya, dalam sembilan bulan pertama 2026, pemerintah Israel merosot atau merusak lebih dari 10.000 pohon Palestina dan saplings di seluruh Tepi Barat, kebanyakan zaitun, pernyataan menambahkan. Tim Negara Kemanusiaan untuk Wilayah Palestina, yang membawa tubuh PBB dan LSM kemanusiaan, mengatakan lebih dari 400 pemukim Israel menyerang pada panen zaitun Palestina sejak September telah mengakibatkan korban atau kerusakan properti, termasuk lebih dari 4.000 pohon dan saplings. Jumlah serangan tahun ini melebihi yang direkam dalam musim panen zaitun sebelumnya. Tahun ini jendela panen ditutup, kata tim, tapi masih ada beberapa waktu untuk bertindak. "LSM Kemanusiaan dan agen-agen PBB mendesak pemerintah Israel dengan cara yang paling mungkin: mengakhiri semua serangan terhadap Palestina dan mata pencaharian mereka, sesuai dengan hukum internasional. Pastikan petani memiliki akses bebas, aman, cukup dan dapat diandalkan ke tanah mereka. Tim menambahkan bahwa pelaku harus dihentikan dan diadakan untuk account," pernyataan yang dibaca.
articles.originalTitle: Israel has not acted on calls to protect Palestinian olive farmers, Ocha says
articles.originalDescription: Israel has not acted on calls to protect Palestinian olive farmers, Ocha says Calls on the Israeli authorities to protect Palestinian olive farmers and ensure they can reach their groves safely have not been acted upon, the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (Ocha) said, citing the Humanitarian Country Team. Instead, in the first nine months of 2026, Israeli authorities uprooted or otherwise damaged more than 10,000 Palestinian-owned trees and saplings across the West Bank, mostly olives, the statement adds. The Humanitarian Country Team for the Occupied Palestinian Territory, which brings together UN bodies and humanitarian NGOs, said more than 400 Israeli settler attacks on the Palestinian olive harvest since September have resulted in casualties or damage to property, including to more than 4,000 trees and saplings. The number of attacks this year exceeds that recorded in any previous olive harvest season. This year’s harvesting window is closing, the team said, but there is still some time to act. "Humanitarian NGOs and UN agencies urge the Israeli authorities in the strongest possible terms: end all attacks on Palestinians and their livelihoods, as required by international law. Ensure farmers have free, safe, sufficient and reliable access to their land. The team added that perpetrators must be stopped and held to account," the statement read.

articles.title: UNDP resmi: 'Penderitaan Gaza harus memaksa kita untuk menanyakan pertanyaan sulit'
articles.description: Secara resmi UNDP: 'Penderitaan Gaza harus memaksa kita untuk menanyakan pertanyaan yang sulit' Programme Pengembangan PBB Teratas (UNDP) mengatakan penderitaan yang dialami oleh orang-orang di Gaza "harus memaksa kita untuk mengajukan pertanyaan yang sulit". "Apa yang menyerang Anda segera adalah skala kehancuran di Gaza, di mana lebih dari 90% dari populasi tergantung pada bantuan kemanusiaan. Perbedaan antara apa yang kita anggap normal - makanan, air dan kualitas hidup - dan penderitaan yang dialami oleh orang-orang di Gaza harus memaksa kita untuk mengajukan pertanyaan yang sulit," Haolang Xu, Under- Sekretaris - Jenderal dan Administrator Asosiasi, UNDP, kata. Xu mengatakan fitur mendefinisikan waktu kita adalah "polikrisis, dengan tantangan yang jauh melampaui setiap tempat", menurut posting pada X oleh DIalogues MED. "Konflik di Timur Tengah, misalnya, adalah biaya negara di seluruh wilayah setidaknya 3,6% dari PDB, dengan beberapa perkiraan UNDP mencapai 6%", kata Xu.
articles.originalTitle: UNDP official: 'Gaza's suffering must compel us to ask difficult questions'
articles.originalDescription: UNDP official: 'Gaza's suffering must compel us to ask difficult questions' A top United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) official has said the suffering endured by people in Gaza "must compel us to ask difficult questions". “What strikes you immediately is the scale of the destruction in Gaza, where more than 90% of the population depends on humanitarian assistance. The contrast between what we consider normal—food, water and quality of life—and the suffering endured by people in Gaza must compel us to ask difficult questions,” Haoliang Xu, Under-Secretary-General and Associate Administrator, UNDP, said. Xu said a defining feature of our time is "polycrisis, with challenges that extend far beyond any one place", according to a post on X by MED Dialogues. "The conflict in the Middle East, for example, is costing countries across the region at least 3.6% of GDP, with some UNDP estimates reaching 6%,” Xu said.

articles.title: Trump: 'ICC di luar kendali, tidak bisa masuk dan menangkap kepala dewan'
articles.description: Trump: 'ICC di luar kendali, tidak bisa masuk dan menangkap kepala negara' Presiden AS Donald Trump mengatakan Pengadilan Pidana Internasional adalah "di luar kendali", sambil mengklaim Cina "setuju untuk pertama kalinya untuk mengutuk pelanggaran dan melampaui" pengadilan, laporan AFP. Trump, saat kembali dari pertemuan dengan Xi Jinping dan Vladimir Putin dari Rusia, mengeluh bahwa ICC percaya "mereka bisa masuk dan menangkap para kepala negara, dan mereka tidak bisa melakukan itu. Mereka bisa melakukannya tanpa alasan -- jadi kita mengutuk itu sebagai kelompok". Washington telah bersumpah untuk membongkar pengadilan, yang ditargetkan dengan sanksi baru bulan lalu. Trump telah marah dengan pergerakan pengadilan untuk mengeluarkan surat penangkapan untuk Perdana Menteri Israel Benjamin Netanyahu atas pembantaian Gaza. Washington telah bersumpah untuk membongkar pengadilan, yang ditargetkan dengan sanksi baru bulan lalu. (AFP)
articles.originalTitle: Trump: 'ICC out of control, can't go in and arrest heads of countries'
articles.originalDescription: Trump: 'ICC out of control, can't go in and arrest heads of countries' US President Donald Trump has said the International Criminal Court was "out of control", while claiming China "agreed for the first time to condemn the abuses and overreach" of the court, AFP reported. Trump, on his return from a summit with China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin, complained that the ICC believes "they can go in and arrest the heads of countries, and they can't do that. They can do it for no reason -- so we condemned that as a group." Washington has vowed to dismantle the court, which it targeted with new sanctions last month. Trump has been angered by the tribunal's move to issue an arrest warrant for Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu over Gaza genocide. Washington has vowed to dismantle the court, which it targeted with new sanctions last month. (AFP)

articles.title: Enam orang Palestina tewas dalam serangan Israel di Gaza, pertahanan sipil mengatakan
articles.description: Enam orang Palestina tewas dalam serangan Israel di Gaza, pertahanan sipil mengatakan Israel menyerang enam orang di Jalur Gaza pada hari Jumat, lembaga pertahanan sipil di medan perang hancur wilayah mengatakan AFP, meskipun gencatan senjata. Mahmoud Bassal, juru bicara lembaga pertahanan sipil Gaza, mengatakan bahwa empat orang Palestina tewas dan beberapa lainnya terluka dalam serangan udara Israel barat daya kamp pengungsi Bureij di pusat Jalur Gaza pada hari Jumat. Pertahanan sipil juga mengatakan satu Palestina tewas dalam serangan pesawat tak berawak Israel menargetkan sebuah tenda di kamp Al- Munasara untuk pengungsi orang di Deir Al- Balah. Orang lain tewas dalam serangan pesawat tak berawak utara kamp pengungsi Nuseyat, juga di Jalur Gaza Tengah. Militer Israel mengatakan kepada AFP itu telah "ditargetkan beberapa koperasi militer" dalam beberapa serangan, yang datang sehari setelah tentara mengatakan telah menyelesaikan serangan tanah di Jalur Gaza pusat. Lebih dari 1.600 warga Palestina telah terbunuh sejak dimulainya gencatan senjata, menurut perhitungan AFP berdasarkan data dari Departemen Kesehatan Gaza yang jumlahnya dianggap dapat diandalkan oleh PBB. Laporan oleh AFP
articles.originalTitle: Six Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza, civil defence says
articles.originalDescription: Six Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza, civil defence says Israeli strikes killed six people in the Gaza Strip on Friday, the civil defence agency in the war-shattered territory told AFP, despite a ceasefire. Mahmoud Bassal, the spokesman for Gaza's civil defence agency, said that four Palestinians were killed and several others wounded in an Israeli airstrike southwest of Bureij refugee camp in the central Gaza Strip on Friday. The civil defence also said one Palestinian was killed in an Israeli drone strike targeting a tent in the Al-Munasara camp for displaced people in Deir al-Balah. Another person was killed in a drone strike north of Nuseirat refugee camp, also in the central Gaza Strip. The Israeli military told AFP it had "targeted multiple military operatives" in several strikes, which came a day after the army said it had completed a ground incursion in the central Gaza Strip. More than 1,600 Palestinians have been killed since the start of the ceasefire, according to an AFP tally based on data from the Gaza health ministry whose figures are considered reliable by the United Nations. Report by AFP

articles.title: Ledakan keras terdengar di Riyadh setelah peringatan pertahanan sipil Saudi
articles.description: Ledakan keras terdengar di Riyadh setelah pertahanan sipil Saudi memperingatkan ledakan keras terdengar di ibukota Saudi Riyadh jam pada hari Jumat, saksi mengatakan Reuters, segera setelah pertahanan sipil kerajaan mengeluarkan peringatan bahaya potensial di kota. Pertahanan sipil mengirim pesan kedua segera setelah itu mengatakan bahaya telah berlalu. Penyebab ledakan itu tidak segera jelas. Itu adalah peringatan pertama seperti di Riyadh sejak serangan Houthi menghantam gedung pencakar langit tertinggi pada hari Kamis. Sebelumnya, pertahanan sipil mengeluarkan peringatan serupa untuk pemerintah Sulayyil, di Arab Saudi pusat, sebelum kemudian mengatakan bahaya yang ada juga berlalu.
articles.originalTitle: Loud explosion heard in Riyadh after Saudi civil defence alerts
articles.originalDescription: Loud explosion heard in Riyadh after Saudi civil defence alerts A loud boom was heard in the Saudi capital Riyadh late hours on Friday, a witness told Reuters, shortly after the kingdom’s civil defence issued an alert warning of potential danger in the city. The civil defence sent a second message soon afterwards saying the danger had passed. The cause of the boom was not immediately clear. It was the first such alert in Riyadh since a Houthi attack struck the capital’s tallest skyscraper on Thursday. Earlier, the civil defence issued a similar alert for al-Sulayyil governorate, in central Saudi Arabia, before later saying the danger there had also passed.

articles.originalTitle: Inside the Iraqi Kurdish city caught between the US and Iran
articles.originalDescription: Inside the Iraqi Kurdish city caught between the US and Iran Submitted by Sean Mathews on Fri, 11/20/2026 - 19:37 Sulaymaniyah is reeling from the economic toll of the Iran war and grappling with an emboldened regional power next door A market in the city of Sulaymaniyah in Iraq's Kurdistan Region is said to be the largest bazaar in the region, on 11 November 2026 (Sean Mathews/MEE) Off If US President Donald Trump has his way, Baran* will be out of business. The thirty-year-old Kurd is a trader who buys diesel in Iraq and sells it in Afghanistan. It’s a stressful gig, but one that can generate a tidy profit in a place like Iraqi Kurdistan. A truck laden with $20,000 worth of diesel in Iraq can sell in Kabul for around $24,000, leaving around $2,000 for the trader once expenses are paid. But it has to make it through Iran first. “The journey is more dangerous now. It’s harder to find drivers. The border isn’t as reliable. The price of diesel has also shot up,” Baran, whose name has been changed to protect his identity, told Middle East Eye. Trump says instead of restarting strikes on Iran, he wants to choke its economy. In addition to a naval blockade, the US is pressing countries like Turkey , Iraq and Pakistan to seal their borders with Iran. Earlier this month, the US announced a task force to blockade trade across Iran’s land borders and the Caspian Sea. Baran has no political beef with the US. On the contrary, he says, “George W. Bush overthrew Saddam Hussein. He helped Kurdistan. I don’t prefer Iran to the US,” he said over a glass of anise-flavoured Arak and hookahs at a restaurant in Sulaymaniyah. “But this war has not been good for business or our economy.” Baran is a microcosm of the city he calls home. Sulaymaniyah Nestled in the Zagros Mountains, Sulaymaniyah is Iraqi Kurdistan’s second largest city.
